ranking_policy: Source priority plus recency; curated view balances topics and caps each source. Not popularity or proof verification.

items.title: Ramanujan Conjecture and Riemann Hypothesis for the unitary groups over function fields
items.excerpt: We establish generic local and global Langlands functoriality, namely stable base change, for the unitary groups in characteristic $p$. Main applications are the Ramanujan Conjecture and the Riemann Hypothesis for extended Langlands-Shahidi $L$-functions of the unitary groups over function fields.

items.title: Gaps for PLRS with zero coefficients
items.excerpt: Zeckendorf proved that every positive integer has a unique decomposition as a sum of non-adjacent Fibonacci numbers. Among its extensions, we focus on Positive Linear Recurrence Sequences (PLRS): fixed depth recurrences with non-negative integral coefficients whose first and last terms are positive: $G_{n+1} = c_1 G_n + \dots + c_L G_{n-L+1}$ with $c_i$ non-negative integers and $c_1 c_L \ge 1$. We again find every integer can be written uniquely as an appropriate sum of terms of the sequence, and we can study the distribution of gaps between summands in decompositions. Bower et al. (2015) proved that if each $c_i \ge 1$ then the distribution of gaps in the generalized Zeckendorf decompositions of integers in $[G_n, G_{n+1})$ converges to a geometric decay for gaps at least two. What if some of the $c_i$'s are allowed to be zero? To date only the Kangaroo case, where there is a fixed $g$ such that $c_i = 1$ if $i \equiv 1 \bmod g$ and 0 otherwise, has been done and again geometric behavior emerges. Ben-Ari and Miller (2016) developed a probabilistic framework that also produce similar results, but their approach requires more advanced

items.title_zh: 零系数 PLRS 的间隙

items.title: Dihedral fields with Bloch lattice index five and quadratic subfield Q(i)
items.excerpt: We construct infinitely many Galois extensions $M/\mathbb{Q}$ with dihedral group of order ten, quadratic subfield $\mathbb{Q}(i)$, and Bloch lattice index $Q_2(M)=5$. More precisely, we specify a Chebotarev set of rational primes of density $1/50$. For every prime $\ell$ in this set, at least two of four mixed cyclic quintic extensions of $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ of conductor $(25\ell)$ have this index and satisfy $K_2(O_M)(5)\simeq(\mathbb{Z}/5)^2$. A two-dimensional cup-product pencil selects the extensions. Generalized Bockstein maps, integral co-descent, and a motivic genus formula then determine the tame kernel and the subfield Bloch-lattice index. The result is unconditional.

items.title: Recovering Dirichlet coefficients from even samples
items.excerpt: In this work, we determine the exact case error for recovering a Dirichlet coefficient from finitely many positive even samples with bounded additive errors. For sequences with a bounded tail and an unrestricted initial block, a polynomial estimator is minimax among all recovery maps. Its tail and noise constants admit explicit product formulas. We prove a sharp tail asymptotic on the index scale K^(3/2) and give a terminating procedure for selecting the sample count from a computable error bound.

items.title: Diamond Maximal Operators: Classification, Moduli, and Oscillation Envelopes
items.excerpt: We study maximal averages generated by bounded cancellative kernels taking values in finite-dimensional real normed spaces, on Euclidean balls and on balls in a non-Archimedean local field with a fixed uniformizer. For angular kernels, pointwise domination of the full maximal operators is equivalent to factorization of their angular averaging maps, with the same optimal constant. Nonzero scalar angular comparison classes are therefore projective kernel classes. For angular kernels constant on a fixed finite measurable partition of the direction space, symmetric convex bodies classify exact norm measurements, Grassmannians parametrize nonzero classes under mutual domination, and positive semidefinite Gram matrices classify Hilbert-valued measurements. For general kernels, the closed convex hull of the averaging densities obtained from all scales and the dual unit ball is a complete invariant of the full maximal operator. A dilation example exhibits identifications of residue kernels beyond scaling and unit-coordinate changes. For nonzero radial residue kernels on bounded inputs, mutual domination is classified by the unit-circle zeros

items.title: On the Ramanujan-Ligozat modular unit
items.excerpt: Let $\chi$ be the quadratic Dirichlet character of conductor $N$ associated with a given real quadratic field $k$ and let $X_\chi(N)$ be the double covering of $X_0(N)$ associated with $\chi$. In this note, we study a modular unit $f$ on the curve $X_\chi(N)$. We prove that the transform of $f$ by the Fricke involution $\mathscr{w}_N$ is the level $N$ analogue of the Rogers-Ramanujan continued fraction introduced by Lee and Park. Furthermore, if $N$ is a positive prime discriminant, then $f$ is Ligozat's modular unit, which is known from Mazur's work on the Eisenstein ideal. We extend Ligozat's construction to any positive fundamental discriminant $N$.
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $\chi$ 为与给定实二次场 $k$ 关联的导体 $N$ 的二次狄利克雷特征，并令 $X_\chi(N)$ 为与 $\chi$ 关联的 $X_0(N)$ 的双重覆盖。在本文中，我们研究曲线 $X_\chi(N)$ 上的模块化单元 $f$。我们证明$f$通过Fricke对合$\mathscr{w}_N$的变换是Lee和Park引入的Rogers-Ramanujan连续分数的$N$级类似物。此外，如果 $N$ 是正素判别式，那么 $f$ 就是 Ligozat 的模单元，这是从 Mazur 关于爱森斯坦理想的工作中得知的。我们将 Ligozat 的构造扩展到任何正的基本判别式 $N$。

items.title: The exact Euclidean window of $\mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{14}]$
items.excerpt: Let $R = \mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{14}]$, let $\pi = 4 + \sqrt{14}$, and let $\mathfrak{p} = (2,\sqrt{14}) = \pi R$ be the prime ideal above $2$. Cavallar and Lemmermeyer studied the multiplicative weighted norms $\phi_{t}(x) = |N(x)|(t/2)^{v_{\pi}(x)}$ and asked for which weights $t$ they are Euclidean functions on $R$. We show that the set of these weights, the Euclidean window of $\mathfrak{p}$, is $(\sqrt{5},T]$, where $T$ is the algebraic number \[ T = \sqrt{\frac{8}{104051\sqrt{2} - 55617\sqrt{7}}} = 2.2468286690\ldots = \sqrt{5} + 0.0107606915\ldots. \] Thus the window is nonempty but not open. We also obtain the integer-valued completely multiplicative Euclidean function $2^{v_{\pi}(x)}|N(x)|^{6}$ on $R$.

items.title: Markoff spectra of Hecke groups
items.excerpt: We study the initial discrete parts of the Markoff spectra of Hecke groups of index $q\ge 5$. Using a digit expansion associated with geodesics and a Perron-type formula, we classify all bi-infinite digit sequences whose Markoff values lie at or below the first accumulation point. We obtain explicit formulas for the discrete spectral values and identify the sequences realizing them, including those attaining the first accumulation point. We also prove that the infinite family of discrete values increases strictly to this point. Our results recover Vulakh's description of the initial discrete spectra through an explicit symbolic approach.
items.title_zh: Hecke 群的马尔可夫谱

items.title: Almost Empty Monochromatic Polygons in Planar Point Sets
items.excerpt: For integers $r \ge 3$, $c \ge 2$, and $s \ge 0$, let $\mathsf{M}_r^{\star}(c,s)$ denote the smallest integer such that any set of at least $\mathsf{M}_r^{\star}(c,s)$ points in the plane in general position (no three on a line), colored with $c$ colors, contains a monochromatic $r$-gon (not necessarily convex) with at most $s$ interior points. Define $\lambda_r^{\star}(c)$ to be the smallest integer such that $\mathsf{M}_r^{\star}(c,\lambda_r^{\star}(c)) < \infty$. The case of triangles, that is, $r=3$, has been studied in recent years. In this paper, we establish bounds on $\lambda_r^{\star}(c)$, for $r \ge 4$. Specifically, in the bichromatic case, we prove that $\lambda_r^{\star}(2)\leq \lfloor\frac{r-2}{2}\rfloor$, for every $r\geq3$. For hexagons, we sharpen this bound to $\lambda_6^{\star}(2)\leq1$, that is, every sufficiently large bichromatic planar point set in general position contains a monochromatic hexagon with at most one interior point. items.title: Unranking $S$-avoiding permutations with two forbidden offsets
items.excerpt: Given a finite family of combinatorial objects with a total order, ranking asks for the position of a given object, and unranking asks for the object occupying a given position. Both provide algorithmic access to families too large to enumerate. Kagey gave a polynomial-time algorithm for several position-restricted families and left open the case of $\{-1,1\}$-avoiding permutations. We show that when $|S| = 2$, the graph of forbidden squares is $2$-regular, a disjoint union of cycles, and that fixing a prefix leaves only paths and untouched cycles. This yields polynomial-time prefix counting, ranking and unranking for every two-element set of offsets, covering $\{-1,1\}$. The same structure gives a short proof that the number of $\{-1,1\}$-avoiding permutations equals the $n$-th m\'enage number for odd $n$ and exceeds it by $2$ for even $n$, proving a conjecture recorded in the OEIS entry A354152.

items.title: Planar Disk Filters and Real Chromatic Roots at Beraha Numbers
items.excerpt: We construct simple plane triangulations whose chromatic polynomials have real roots accumulating at every noninteger Beraha number $B_\ell=4\cos^2(\pi/\ell)$; the integer values $0,1,2,3$ are roots of $K_4$. The construction rests on the observation that a triangulated disk with four boundary vertices acts, inside a larger triangulation, as a transfer operator lying in a commutative three-parameter algebra. Rotating such disks by a quarter turn and composing them in series moves their eigenvalue triples around this algebra in a controllable way, and for every fixed $q\in(B_{10},4)$ one can manufacture a finite disk whose two competing local eigenvalues are strictly dominated by the third -- a physical filter. Closing a grid of such disks between two poles produces a sphere triangulation, and a fused Temperley-Lieb trace identity accounts for its chromatic polynomial completely, sector by sector, with no appeal to semisimplicity at the root of unity itself -- generic semisimplicity enters only through polynomial identities continued from $\delta>2$ -- and no singular higher Jones-Wenzl projectors. items.title: New lower bounds for binary constant-weight codes from prescribed-automorphism search, and two quantum codes meeting their upper bounds
items.excerpt: We give explicit binary constant-weight codes that raise the lower bounds on $A(n,6,w)$ in eight cells of Brouwer's table, all now listed there. The first round (9 October 2026) gave four values: $A(27,6,11)\ge 19305$, $A(27,6,12)\ge 24453$, $A(28,6,10)\ge 18642$ and $A(28,6,9)\ge 11154$, together with an explicit $A(24,6,12)$ code of 5566 words, now in the table's list of lost codes. The second round (14 October 2026) gave seven values, listed in the table since 15 October 2026: $A(29,6,10)\ge 27183$, $A(29,6,11)\ge 42042$, $A(29,6,9)\ge 14781$, $A(28,6,10)\ge 19110$, $A(27,6,12)\ge 24804$, $A(28,6,9)\ge 11388$ and $A(27,6,13)\ge 27783$, three of which replace first-round values. Every code is a union of orbits of the semilinear affine group $\mathrm{A\Gamma L}(1,27)$, its index-2 subgroup, or $\mathrm{AGL}(1,23)$, acting on all but at most two coordinates. The orbits were chosen by maximum-weight independent set search on the orbit conflict graph: branch and bound in the first round, iterated local search in the second. items.title: Sharp zero forcing numbers for the generalized Petersen graphs $P(n,3)$ and $P(n,4)$
items.excerpt: We prove that $Z(P(n,3))=8$ for every $n\ge13$ and $Z(P(n,4))=10$ for every $n\ge18$, with both stabilization thresholds sharp, and give the exact values for all smaller admissible $n$. The first equality proves Krishnan's Conjecture 5; his Proposition 4 supplies its upper bound. The lower bounds use the external boundary of the first forcing sources: ten vertices have boundary at least eight in $P(n,3)$ for $n\ge14$, and sixteen vertices have boundary at least ten in $P(n,4)$ for $n\ge20$. Deletion within an empty column interval reduces these assertions to finite checks, and forts settle the remaining cases. The $k=3$ stabilization theorem has a Lean 4 formalization; the $k=4$ proof uses 89 boundary formulas and 11 fort formulas with separately checked DRAT certificates, together with explicit forcing sequences.
items.authors: Arnav Krishnan, Haobo Ma, Wenlin Zhang
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，对于每个 $n\ge13$，$Z(P(n,3))=8$ 和对于每个 $n\ge18$，$Z(P(n,4))=10$，两个稳定阈值都很尖锐，并给出所有较小的允许 $n$ 的精确值。第一个等式证明了克里希南猜想5；他的命题 4 提供了它的上限。下界使用第一强制源的外部边界：对于 $n\ge14$，十个顶点在 $P(n,3)$ 中具有至少八个边界，对于 $n\ge20$，十六个顶点在 $P(n,4)$ 中具有至少十个边界。空列间隔内的删除将这些断言减少为有限的检查，并解决剩余的情况。 $k=3$ 稳定定理具有 Lean 4 形式化； $k=4$ 证明使用 89 个边界公式和 11 个堡垒公式以及单独检查的 DRAT 证书，以及显式的强制序列。

items.title: PArcK trees can get as hot as you want
items.excerpt: We consider the combinatorial game Partizan Arc Kayles as a generalization of Domineering. An extensive technical search using genetic algorithms found hot positions of temperature exceeding 2. We discuss this search and construct a family of positions with high temperature that includes these graphs and prove that Partizan Arc Kayles has unbounded temperature. We identify an infinite family of second-player win positions as part of our main construction.
items.authors: Svenja Huntemann, Neil A. McKay, Craig Tennenhouse
items.excerpt_zh: 我们将组合游戏 Partizan Arc Kayles 视为 Domineering 的概括。使用遗传算法进行的广泛技术搜索发现温度超过 2 的热点位置。我们讨论该搜索并构建包含这些图的高温位置族，并证明 Partizan Arc Kayles 具有无界温度。我们确定了无限系列的第二玩家获胜位置作为我们主要构建的一部分。

items.title: The Kemeny-Braess Paradox in Random Graphs
items.excerpt: In 2016, Kirkland and Zeng initiated the mathematical treatment of Braess paradox for random walks on graphs using Kemeny's constant as the measure of travel time. We study this phenomenon for the Erd\H{o}s-R\'enyi random graph $G(n,p)$. An edge in a connected graph is called Kemeny-Braess if its deletion preserves connectedness and decreases Kemeny's constant, while a nonedge is Kemeny-Braess if its insertion increases Kemeny's constant. Let $\bar d=(n-1)p$ be the expected degree of $G\sim G(n,p)$, and assume that $\bar d-\log n\to\infty$, so that $G$ is connected with high probability. We determine the sharp asymptotic thresholds for the existence of both types of paradoxical behaviour. With $C^*=1/(1-\log 2)$, the threshold for Kemeny-Braess edges is $\bar d=C^*\log n$, whereas the threshold for Kemeny-Braess nonedges is $\bar d=2C^*\log n$. Hence, as the expected degree $\bar d$ increases, the connected regime exhibits three phases: first Kemeny-Braess paradox occurs for both edges and nonedges, then only for nonedges, and finally it disappears. In particular, in the dense regime, with high probability $G$ has no Kemeny-Braess edg
items.authors: Manuel Bodirsky, Lorenzo Ciardo, Mihyun Kang
items.excerpt_zh: 2016 年，Kirkland 和 Zeng 使用 Kemeny 常数作为旅行时间的度量，开始对图上随机游走的 Braess 悖论进行数学处理。我们针对 Erd\H{o}s-R\'enyi 随机图 $G(n,p)$ 研究这种现象。如果连通图中的一条边的删除保留了连通性并减小了 Kemeny 常数，则该边称为 Kemeny-Braess；如果插入增加了 Kemeny 常数，则非边称为 Kemeny-Braess。设$\bar d=(n-1)p$为$G\sim G(n,p)$的期望度，并假设$\bar d-\log n\to\infty$，因此$G$以高概率连接。我们确定了两种类型的悖论行为存在的尖锐渐近阈值。对于 $C^*=1/(1-\log 2)$，Kemeny-Braess 边的阈值是 $\bar d=C^*\log n$，而 Kemeny-Braess 非边的阈值是 $\bar d=2C^*\log n$。因此，随着预期度 $\bar d$ 的增加，连通状态呈现出三个阶段：首先，Kemeny-Braess 悖论在边和非边上都发生，然后仅在非边上发生，最后消失。特别是，在密集状态下，$G$ 很可能没有 Kemeny-Braess edg

items.title: Energy of signed graphs and the vertex cover number
items.excerpt: The energy $\mathcal{E}(\Gamma)$ of a signed graph $\Gamma=(G,\sigma)$ is the sum of the absolute values of the eigenvalues of its adjacency matrix $A(\Gamma)$. In this article, we prove that $\mathcal{E}(\Gamma)\geq 2\tau(G)$, where $\tau(G)$ is the vertex cover number of $G$. The case of unsigned graphs, a 1980s conjecture proved only recently, is a special case of this result. Moreover, we completely characterize the equality case: equality holds if and only if every connected component of $\Gamma$ is switching equivalent to an \emph{additive rook graph} $\Rook_N(a,b)$. This graph is constructed on an $N\times N$ board with $a_i+b_j$ vertices on square $(i,j)$. Two vertices are joined by a positive edge if they share only a row, and by a negative edge if they share only a column. As consequences, we obtain a balanced/antibalanced trichotomy for the extremal signed graphs and deduce the characterization of the extremal unsigned graphs. Finally, an example shows that the bound does not extend to the Hermitian adjacency matrices of mixed graphs or to complex unit gain graphs.
items.authors: Aniruddha Samanta, Deepshikha, Kinkar Chandra Das
items.excerpt_zh: 有符号图 $\Gamma=(G,\sigma)$ 的能量 $\mathcal{E}(\Gamma)$ 是其邻接矩阵 $A(\Gamma)$ 的特征值绝对值之和。在本文中，我们证明$\mathcal{E}(\Gamma)\geq 2\tau(G)$，其中$\tau(G)$是$G$的顶点覆盖数。无符号图的情况是这个结果的一个特例，这是一个 20 世纪 80 年代的猜想，直到最近才被证明。此外，我们完全描述了等式情况：当且仅当 $\Gamma$ 的每个连通分量都等价于 \emph{additive rook graph} $\Rook_N(a,b)$ 时，等式成立。该图是在 $N\times N$ 板上构建的，$a_i+b_j$ 顶点位于正方形 $(i,j)$ 上。如果两个顶点仅共享行，则通过正边连接；如果两个顶点仅共享列，则通过负边连接。结果，我们获得了极值有符号图的平衡/反平衡三分法，并推导出极值无符号图的表征。最后，一个示例表明该界限不会扩展到混合图的埃尔米特邻接矩阵或复杂的单位增益图。

items.title: Invariants of big classes from asymptotic total Betti numbers
items.excerpt: We introduce and study a new numerical invariant of big line bundles on normal complex projective varieties, defined in terms of the total Betti number of hypersurfaces associated with high tensor powers of the line bundle. We prove that this invariant is birational and provides an upper bound for the volume of the line bundle. When the big line bundle admits a rational Zariski decomposition, we show that the invariant coincides with the volume. In particular, this holds when the line bundle is ample or is defined on a projective surface. We also investigate the analogous problem in the real algebraic setting, proving the existence of real algebraic hypersurfaces associated with high tensor powers of a big line bundle whose real vanishing loci have arbitrarily large total Betti numbers.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们引入并研究了正态复射影簇上大线束的一个新的数值不变量，它是根据与线束的高张量幂相关的超曲面的总 Betti 数来定义的。我们证明这个不变量是双有理的，并提供了线束体积的上限。当大线丛允许有理 Zariski 分解时，我们证明不变量与体积一致。特别是，当线束充足或定义在投影表面上时，这一点成立。我们还研究了实代数环境中的类似问题，证明了与大线丛的高张量幂相关的实代数超曲面的存在，该线丛的实消失轨迹具有任意大的总贝蒂数。

items.title: Codimension of Brill-Noether Loci on Abelian Surfaces and the First Segre Invariant
items.excerpt: Let $X$ be an abelian surface of Picard rank 1 with ample generator $H$. We show that, for a Mukai vector $\mathbf{v}=(r,mH,\chi)$ with $r,m\geq 1$ and $\chi\leq 0$, the first Brill-Noether loci $\{E \;|\; H^0(E)\neq 0\}$ in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$ is nonempty of the expected codimension $1-\chi$. As an application, we study the rank 1 Segre invariant on these abelian surfaces. Specifically, for $\mathbf{v}$ a Mukai vector of a $\mu$-stable sheaf of $\mathrm{rank}\geq 2$, we compute the Segre invariant of the general sheaf in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$, and we determine the numbers which arise as the Segre invariant of a sheaf in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$.

items.title: The Yau Geometric Conjecture for Isolated Hypersurface Singularities
items.excerpt: This paper presents a proof of the long-standing Yau Geometric Conjecture.
items.authors: Siyuan Fu, Stephen S. -T. Yau, Huaiqing Zuo
items.title_zh: 孤立超曲面奇点的丘几何猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 本文提出了长期存在的丘几何猜想的证明。

items.title: Derived equivalences and isogenies of supersingular abelian varieties
items.excerpt: We study (twisted) Fourier-Mukai partners of supersingular abelian varieties. We give a simple proof that any two supersingular abelian varieties of the same dimension at least two are derived isogenous, answering a question raised by Li, Lu, and Tang and generalizing the result of Li and Zou. Moreover, in every dimension greater than two, we construct derived-equivalent supersingular abelian varieties whose corresponding positive powers are never isomorphic. We also give conditions under which derived equivalence between two supersingular principally polarized abelian varieties implies that their underlying abelian varieties are isomorphic. In particular, this implication holds in dimensions at most three.
items.authors: An Jiang, Zhiyuan Li, Ziwei Lu
items.title_zh: 超奇异阿贝尔簇的导出等价性和同源性

items.title: On the classification of threefold flops
items.excerpt: We show that possibly singular threefold flopping contractions are completely classified by their associated derived contraction algebras, considered up to derived Morita equivalence; in contrast to the smooth case the extra derived structure is necessary in general. This extends previous work of the author on simple flops, and follows from a more general theorem about isolated hypersurface singularities. The key new input is to show that derived localisation at a Hochschild class is Morita invariant; this result raises some interesting questions related to the classification of recollements. We also show that derived contraction algebras admit a deformation-theoretic interpretation in families in a general setting that encompasses threefold flops, flips, and divisor-to-curve contractions.

items.title: Alp\"oge's counterexample to the JC, Economic Stabilization, and Zhao's Vanishing Conjecture
items.excerpt: In this paper, we apply stabilization techniques which are economic in the number of added dimensions to a slightly tweaked version of Alp\"oge's counterexample to JC(3) and JC(3,7). The first idea which lead to more economic stabilization is to bypass the degree 3 reduction of Bass, Connell and Wright in the construction of a counterexample to HJC(n). We construct counterexamples to HJC(15), VC(28), and HVC(30). On the other hand, we will perform degree 3 reduction after all to obtain counterexamples of low degree. We construct counterexamples to JC(12,3), HJC(18,3), VC(34,4), and HVC(36,4). As an encore, we construct a cubic-linear counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture in dimension 90. All presented counterexamples to the Jacobian Conjecture (Vanishing Conjecture) are over the (Gaussian) integers.
items.title_zh: 阿尔普奥格对JC的反例、经济稳定和赵氏消失猜想

items.title: Weighted homogeneous surface singularities admitting rational homology disk smoothings
items.excerpt: We study rational homology disk smoothings through canonical-cover representations and specialization of reflexive canonical powers, and recover the known dual graph and analytic classification. The geometric-genus representation of the canonical covering group, together with its complex conjugate, is a direct summand of the reduced regular representation. Specialization forces the canonical Riemann--Roch corrections to vanish; explicit formulas give equations for the Seifert invariants. For three arms and central weight two, these equations, the character restrictions, and the numerical identities determine the Seifert data without assuming the existence of a smoothing. Projective compactifications treat the remaining cases, and elliptic pencils explain the four-arm attachment points and the parameter independence of their cross ratios. We construct strong $\mathbb{Q}$-Gorenstein smoothings for all listed analytic structures by deforming canonical-cover equations and lifting generators of the full first syzygy module. The numerical Milnor formula gives rational homology disk fibers.
items.title_zh: 允许有理同源盘平滑的加权齐次表面奇点

items.title: The section conjecture for generic pointed curves
items.excerpt: Let $k/\mathbb Q$ be finitely generated, let $g\geq3$ and $n\geq1$, and let $\mathcal M_{g,n/k}$ be the moduli stack of smooth proper genus-$g$ curves with $n$ distinct ordered markings. Put $K=k(\mathcal M_{g,n/k})$. We prove Grothendieck's section conjecture for the generic $n$-pointed genus-$g$ curve over $K$. Over both the moduli stack and its function field, the continuous sections of the arithmetic fundamental-group extension of the universal complete curve are, up to geometric conjugacy, exactly the $n$ tautological sections. The same classification holds for every geometrically pro-$\ell$ quotient, for every prime $\ell$. Together with Hain's determination of the rational points, these classifications give examples over fields finitely generated over $\mathbb Q$ with any prescribed positive number of rational points for which the full section conjecture holds. The proof builds on Hain's weighted-completion and nonabelian cohomology methods, with a hyperelliptic calculation providing the genus-three input. An integral normalizer lemma and moving-mark arguments pass from unipotent sections to geometrically pro-$\ell$ sections. C
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $k/\mathbb Q$ 是有限生成的，令 $g\geq3$ 和 $n\geq1$ ，并令 $\mathcal M_{g,n/k}$ 为具有 $n$ 不同有序标记的平滑真属 $g$ 曲线的模堆栈。输入$K=k(\mathcal M_{g,n/k})$。我们证明了格洛腾迪克关于 $K$ 上通用 $n$ 指向的亏格-$g$ 曲线的截面猜想。在模堆栈及其函数域上，通用完全曲线的算术基本群扩展的连续部分，直到几何共轭，正是 $n$ 同义反复部分。对于每个素数 $\ell$，每个几何上的商 $\ell$ 都适用相同的分类。连同 Hain 对有理点的确定，这些分类给出了在 $\mathbb Q$ 上有限生成的域的示例，其中具有全截面猜想成立的任何规定的正数有理点。该证明建立在 Hain 的加权完成和非阿贝尔上同调方法的基础上，并通过超椭圆计算提供了属三输入。积分归一化引理和移动标记参数从单能部分传递到几何上的 pro-$\ell$ 部分。 C

items.title: A Central Limit Theorem for Intrinsic Fr\'echet Means on Real Grassmannians
items.excerpt: Subspace-valued data arise in dimension reduction, image-set and video recognition, and signal processing, and the Fr\'echet mean is their standard sample mean [11,9,15,23]. We establish a central limit theorem for the intrinsic sample Fr\'echet mean of i.i.d. observations on the real Grassmann manifold $\mathrm{Gr}(p,n)$, as a specialization of the general theorem of [18]. Unlike prior results which require the distribution to vanish or place negligible mass near the cut locus of the population mean, we allow a continuous, possibly positive density. To enable our results, we derive two properties of $\mathrm{Gr}(p,n)$: the first is that the union of the cut loci of all points within distance $\delta$ of the mean has volume $O(\delta)$. The second is that the Hessian of the squared distance function is integrable. We also give a smooth density on $\mathrm{Gr}(1,2)$ for which the mean is unique but the Fr\'echet Hessian vanishes.
items.authors: Bipayan Banerjee, Imon Banerjee, Swagatam Das
items.excerpt_zh: 子空间值数据出现在降维、图像集和视频识别以及信号处理中，Fr'echet 均值是它们的标准样本均值 [11,9,15,23]。我们为 i.i.d. 的内在样本 Fr'echet 均值建立了中心极限定理。对实格拉斯曼流形 $\mathrm{Gr}(p,n)$ 的观察，作为[18]一般定理的专门化。与之前的结果不同，之前的结果要求分布消失或在总体平均值的切割轨迹附近放置可忽略不计的质量，我们允许连续的、可能为正的密度。为了获得我们的结果，我们推导出 $\mathrm{Gr}(p,n)$ 的两个属性：第一个是均值距离 $\delta$ 内所有点的切割轨迹的并集具有体积 $O(\delta)$。第二个是平方距离函数的 Hessian 矩阵是可积的。我们还给出了 $\mathrm{Gr}(1,2)$ 上的平滑密度，其均值是唯一的，但 Fr\'echet Hessian 消失了。

items.title: Optimal dimension growth rates in the high dimensional Central Limit Theorems
items.excerpt: We investigate the optimal dimension growth rates for the high-dimensional Central Limit Theorem (CLT) over half spaces, Euclidean balls and Borel convex sets, under the existence of fourth moments. It has been observed in the literature that $d=o(n^c)$ with $0< c\leq 1/2$ is sufficient for the CLT to hold over Euclidean balls. As a consequence, the CLT over half spaces should ideally hold under similar dimension growth rates. In case of Borel convex sets, however $d= o(n^{c})$ with $0< c\leq 2/5$ is generally sufficient. The most recent results for CLT over Euclidean balls and Borel convex sets with respective rates $d= o(\sqrt{n})$ and $d= o(n^{2/5})$ is due to Fang and Koike (2024) and under the existence of fourth moments. In this paper, we investigate whether these sufficient growth rates of $d$ with respect to $n$ are also necessary. Thus, our results completely characterize the sharpness of dimension growth rates under existence of fourth moments across half-spaces, Euclidean balls, and Borel convex sets.
items.title_zh: 高维中心极限定理中的最优维度增长率
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了在四阶矩存在下，半空间、欧氏球和 Borel 凸集上高维中心极限定理 (CLT) 的最优维数增长率。在文献中观察到，$d=o(n^c)$ 且 $0< c\leq 1/2$ 足以使 CLT 保持在欧几里得球之上。因此，理想情况下，超过一半空间的 CLT 应保持在类似的尺寸增长率下。然而，对于 Borel 凸集，$d= o(n^{c})$ 且 $0< c\leq 2/5$ 通常就足够了。欧几里得球和 Borel 凸集上的 CLT 的最新结果（分别为 $d= o(\sqrt{n})$ 和 $d= o(n^{2/5})$ 是由 Fang 和 Koike (2024) 在第四矩存在的情况下得出的。在本文中，我们研究了 $d$ 相对于 $n$ 的这些足够的增长率是否也是必要的。因此，我们的结果完全表征了在半空间、欧几里得球和 Borel 凸集上存在四阶矩的情况下维度增长率的锐度。

items.title: Sums of two dependent uniform random variables: a characterization by joint tail bounds
items.excerpt: Which laws can the sum of two uniform random variables have when nothing is known about how they depend on each other? For three or more uniform summands, convex order gives the answer; for two it does not, and the question has been open. We show that the attainable laws are exactly those that satisfy a family of explicit joint bounds on sums of tail probabilities, one bound for each finite set of thresholds. For laws with a density at most one, convex order alone decides. For densities at most two, convex order implies the simplest of the joint bounds, and the constant two cannot be raised for single-threshold bounds. The number of thresholds a law needs is set by the spacing of its atoms, not by how many atoms it has.
items.title_zh: 两个相关均匀随机变量的总和：联合尾边界的表征
items.excerpt_zh: 当两个均匀随机变量如何相互依赖一无所知时，它们的总和可以有哪些定律？对于三个或更多均匀被加数，凸阶给出答案；对于两个人来说，情况并非如此，而且这个问题一直悬而未决。我们证明，可达到的定律正是满足尾部概率和的一系列显式联合界限的定律，每个有限阈值集都有一个界限。对于密度最多为 1 的定律，仅由凸阶决定。对于密度最多为 2 的情况，凸阶意味着最简单的联合边界，并且对于单阈值边界不能提高常数 2。定律所需的阈值数量是由其原子的间距决定的，而不是由其拥有的原子数量决定的。

items.title: Almost-optimal bulk regularity conditions in the CLT for G$\beta$E
items.excerpt: We consider linear statistics $\sum_{k=1}^N f(x_k)$ of a Gaussian $\b$-ensemble. Following the work of \cite{LaSo22}, which was concerned only with Wigner matrices, we extend their results for general $\b$. In particular, we show that the CLT holds for any $f \in H^{1/2 + \e}$. The novel input which was not used in \cite{LaSo22} is the Helffer-Sj\"ostrand representation for the covariance, first appearing the random matrix context in \cite{ErYa15}, coupled with characteristic flow estimates for DBM, first appearing in \cite{Bo22}.
items.title_zh: G$\beta$E 的 CLT 中几乎最优的批量正则性条件

items.title: Rapid convergence of Langevin AIS for multimodal distributions on $\mathbb{R}^d$
items.excerpt: We study annealed importance sampling (AIS) driven by the overdamped Langevin diffusion, targeting a multimodal Gibbs measure $\pi_\varepsilon \propto e^{-U/\varepsilon}$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$ at low temperature $\varepsilon$. For a potential $U$ with nondegenerate critical points, finitely many wells of comparable mass, and at least quadratic growth at infinity, we show that AIS with a harmonically spaced temperature schedule produces a weighted empirical measure that approximates $\pi_\varepsilon$ to accuracy $\delta$ at a total cost of order $\varepsilon^{-2}\delta^{-2}$, up to logarithmic factors, and the exponents do not depend on the dimension. This is an exponential improvement over plain Langevin Monte Carlo, whose relaxation time obeys the Arrhenius law. The assumptions cover, in particular, the potentials of Gaussian mixtures, as long as their critical points are nondegenerate and their wells carry comparable mass. The analysis extends that of arXiv:2604.17526 [math.PR] from the torus $\mathbb{T}^d$ to the noncompact state space $\mathbb{R}^d$. The two new ingredients are a weighted $L^\infty$ bound on the eigenfunctions of the
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了由过阻尼朗之万扩散驱动的退火重要性采样（AIS），目标是低温 $\varepsilon$ 上 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 上的多模态吉布斯测度 $\pi_\varepsilon \propto e^{-U/\varepsilon}$。对于具有非简并临界点的潜在 $U$、有限多个具有可比质量的井以及至少在无穷远处二次增长，我们表明，具有谐波间隔温度计划的 AIS 会产生一个加权经验测量，该加权经验测量将 $\pi_\varepsilon$ 近似到精确度 $\delta$，总成本为 $\varepsilon^{-2}\delta^{-2}$，直至对数因子，并且指数不依赖于维度。与普通的朗之万蒙特卡罗相比，这是指数级的改进，其弛豫时间遵循阿伦尼乌斯定律。这些假设特别涵盖高斯混合物的潜力，只要它们的临界点是非简并的并且它们的井具有相当的质量。该分析将 arXiv:2604.17526 [math.PR] 的分析从环面 $\mathbb{T}^d$ 扩展到非紧状态空间 $\mathbb{R}^d$。这两个新成分是在特征函数上的加权$L^\infty$

items.title: Void probabilities for perturbed lattices under mixing
items.excerpt: We study void probabilities for stationary perturbed lattices with possibly dependent perturbations. Our main result gives a general upper bound in terms of two ingredients: the number of lattice sites having a uniformly positive probability of hitting the observation set, and the $\alpha$-mixing rate of the perturbation field. For unions of lattice cubes, this yields explicit bounds without moment or regularity assumptions on the marginal distribution of the perturbations. As a consequence, we obtain quantitative estimates for growing bounded Borel sets with non-empty interior, including stretched-exponential decay under exponential mixing and polynomial decay under polynomial mixing.
items.title_zh: 混合下扰动晶格的空洞概率
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究具有可能相关扰动的静止扰动晶格的空洞概率。我们的主要结果给出了两个成分的一般上限：具有均匀正概率命中观察集的晶格位置的数量，以及扰动场的 $\alpha$ 混合率。对于格立方的并集，这会产生显式边界，而无需对扰动的边际分布进行矩或规律性假设。因此，我们获得了具有非空内部的增长有界 Borel 集的定量估计，包括指数混合下的拉伸指数衰减和多项式混合下的多项式衰减。

items.title: On the Proportion of Time that a Conventional Confidence Interval Covers
items.excerpt: The concept of confidence sequences, or `anytime confidence intervals,' has attracted significant interest in recent years. This motivates the question of how well conventional confidence intervals behave when similarly evaluated. In particular, we study the probability distribution of the proportion of time a conventional confidence interval procedure covers the population mean, when the total time $n$ spent sampling is large. We establish an invariance principle for the limiting distribution as $n$ tends to infinity and show that the limit random variable $Z(1)$ can be expressed as a functional of Brownian motion. The random variable $Z(1)$ exhibits a scale invariance property that enables the derivation of a partial differential equation (PDE) for the density of $Z(1)$ jointly with the Brownian motion at $t=1$, namely $B(1)$. We show that this density can also be computed as the stationary distribution of a two-dimensional singular diffusion, one component of which is an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process. We then derive an approximating Markov chain that allows us to numerically solve the PDE. This density has a number of interesting feat

items.title: Probabilistic large deviations approach to obstacle Hamilton-Jacobi equations
items.excerpt: In this paper, we derive a non-classical variational representation of a viscosity solution of a Hamilton-Jacobi equation with obstacle, in which the Hamiltonian may take infinite values. We study a nonlinear selection-mutation model with an exponential-decay mutation kernel, using a probabilistic Feynman-Kac representation of a pure jump process. To handle the singular character of this process, we rely on a non-standard tool from large deviations theory, which allows us to establish a Varadhan-type lemma. This, in turn, yields the variational representation of the viscosity solution.

items.title: Reusable QUBO-Derived Block-Schur Inverse Factors for Fixed-Operator Finite-Difference PDE Solvers
items.excerpt: Many simulations of partial differential equations require the repeated solution of linear systems whose matrix remains fixed while the righthand side changes. We present a hybrid offline online framework for this setting. The discretized operator is organized into small coupled blocks and reduced through block Schur complements. Instead of expressing the complete PDE solution as one large binary optimization problem, quadratic unconstrained binary optimization is used only to construct reusable local inverse factors. These factors are computed during an offline stage, decoded and stored, and then reused in an ordinary classical block solve for subsequent righthand sides. The optimizer facing problem size is governed by the local block size and chosen numerical precision, rather than by the dimension of the full spatial grid. We develop the mathematical formulation, analyze the accuracy and resource requirements of the binary representation, and examine the method on representative finite difference PDE problems, including execution of the local optimization stage on quantum optimization hardware. The resulting architecture provides a
items.authors: Arash Fath Lipaei, \"Ozg\"ur E. M\"ustecapl{\i}o\u{g}lu, \"Ozlem Salehi, Selin Aslan

items.title: Certified neural approximations for parabolic obstacle problems
items.excerpt: Residual-trained neural surrogates carry no error guarantee, a limitation for free-boundary problems such as phase change and contact. We derive guaranteed error bounds for neural approximations of parabolic obstacle problems in first-order state--flux--multiplier form. The main result bounds the flux error of the network and the energy error of its feasible projection $\max\{v,g\}$ by the constitutive residual, the initial mismatch, the complementarity defect, and the PDE residual weighted by $c_F^2/\alpha$, without the coercivity and norm-equivalence constants of the first-order formulation. It extends the Apushkinskaya--Repin majorant for the heat operator to general coefficients, free multipliers and a flux bound. A penetration-consistency result shows that neural triples with arbitrarily small bound exist. Outward-rounded cellwise Taylor-model enclosures turn the bound into a finite computation valid on any adaptive partition. The flux and gradient errors of the projected output are certified below $0.27$ and $0.33$ of the solution scale for a one-dimensional Stefan problem and, after adaptive refinement, below one half for all t
items.title_zh: 经过认证的抛物线障碍问题的神经近似
items.excerpt_zh: 残差训练的神经代理没有错误保证，这是对相变和接触等自由边界问题的限制。我们推导出一阶状态-通量-乘数形式的抛物线障碍问题的神经逼近的保证误差界。主要结果通过本构残差、初始失配、互补缺陷和由 $c_F^2/\alpha$ 加权的 PDE 残差来限制网络的通量误差及其可行投影 $\max\{v,g\}$ 的能量误差，而无需一阶公式的矫顽力和范数等价常数。它将热算子的 Apushkinskaya-Repin 主线扩展到一般系数、自由乘子和通量约束。渗透一致性结果表明存在任意小边界的神经三元组。外向舍入的单元泰勒模型外壳将界限转变为对任何自适应分区有效的有限计算。经认证，投影输出的通量和梯度误差低于一维 Stefan 问题的解决方案规模的 0.27 美元和 0.33 美元，并且在自适应细化之后，低于所有 t 的二分之一。

items.title: A note on the rectangular Schoenberg-Whitney theorem for clamped B-splines
items.excerpt: Wang et al.(Computer-Aided Design 40 (2008) 999-1008) proposed a knot-subsequence characterization of full row rank for rectangular B-spline collocation matrices. We identify an incorrect inequality in their Appendix proof, which invalidates the argument as written, and make explicit the endpoint and multiplicity conventions on which the criterion depends. The defect lies in the proof, not in the underlying result, which is valid under suitably stated hypotheses; in the lofting construction of Wang et al. these hypotheses are implicitly satisfied, so the lofted curves are unaffected. We state the corrected result and give a new proof, independent of the disputed argument, for clamped B-splines of arbitrary degree with continuous interior multiplicities. In our proof, sufficiency follows from inclusion of spline spaces and knot insertion; necessity selects independent columns and builds the reduced knot vector from them. The proof uses no recursive column-selection construction.
items.excerpt_zh: Wang等人（Computer-Aided Design 40 (2008) 999-1008）提出了矩形B样条配置矩阵的全行秩的结子序列表征。我们在附录证明中发现了一个不正确的不等式，这使得所写的论证无效，并明确了标准所依赖的端点和多重性约定。缺陷在于证明，而不在于潜在的结果，该结果在适当陈述的假设下是有效的；在王等人的放样施工中。这些假设得到隐式满足，因此放样曲线不受影响。我们陈述了修正后的结果，并给出了一个新的证明，独立于有争议的论点，对于具有连续内部重数的任意阶的钳位 B 样条。在我们的证明中，充分性源于包含样条空间和结插入；必要性选择独立的列并从中构建简化的结向量。该证明不使用递归列选择结构。

items.title: A Gauge-Invariant Finite Element Method for the Time-Dependent Ginzburg--Landau Equations
items.excerpt: It is well known that the Ginzburg--Landau equations are gauge invariant. The most popular gauge choice in practical simulations is the temporal gauge, also known as the zero electric potential gauge. However, the commonly used N\'ed\'elec approximations may produce spurious giant vortices on domains with re-entrant corners. To address this issue while retaining the N\'ed\'elec approximation, we propose a finite element scheme that preserves the gauge invariance of the time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau equations at the discrete level. Under the temporal gauge, the method employs lowest-order N\'ed\'elec edge elements for the magnetic potential and continuous piecewise-linear elements for the order parameter on triangular and tetrahedral meshes, and yields a linear, decoupled formulation that requires only the solution of linear systems at each time step. We prove that the scheme is gauge invariant, preserves a discrete maximum bound principle for the order parameter, $\|\psi_h^n\|_{L^\infty(\Omega)}\le 1$, and satisfies a discrete energy law under mild step-size and mesh conditions. Numerical experiments confirm these theoretical proper
items.authors: Huadong Gao, Yuhui Huang, Wen Xie

items.title: The Segal-Bargmann Transform in Neural Partial Differential Equations
items.excerpt: We introduce a novel neural operator method based on Segal-Bargmann transform and Bargmann-Fock space for learning the solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). The method brings data encoding, latent-space representation, operator learning, and decoding into an unifed framework. From only finitely many observations, we establish a sup-norm reconstruction error of order $ L^{-\frac{1}{2}} $, where L is the number of complex sampling points that are decoupled with the original samplings and observations. The reconstruction error is independent of the spatial dimension and the number of original sampling points. We show that this new mesh-free Segal-Bargmann Neural Operator approach has superior performance compared to existing NO approaches like FNO, BelNet, GNOT, etc.,\ particularly in terms of pointwise control $ \sup_{x}\lvert\hat{u}_{NO} - u_{truth}\rvert $ for solutions of PDEs $ \mathcal{L}u = f $ which provides pointwise accuracy and interpretability as classical numerical solvers. items.authors: Jie Xu, Julio Castrill\'on-Cand\'as, Mark Kon, Qinxun Bai

items.title: Skew-Symmetric Formulations and Energy-Stable Schemes for Compressible Reactive Flow Equations
items.excerpt: This paper develops skew-symmetric formulations and energy stable finite difference schemes for the reactive Euler and reactive Navier--Stokes equations. By introducing suitable transformed variables, we rewrite the governing equations into skew-symmetric forms and obtain continuous energy estimates by standard integration-by-parts arguments. The proposed formulations extend the skew-symmetric framework for compressible flow equations to reactive systems, where the chemical energy and the species equation must be incorporated into the transformed variables. Based on these formulations, we construct semi-discrete schemes with summation-by-parts (SBP) operators. The convective terms are discretized by the non-dissipative part of linear upwind SBP operators, while a nonlinear SBP--WENO operator is used only to supply artificial dissipation near discontinuities. For periodic boundary conditions, the resulting schemes satisfy semi-discrete energy estimates consistent with the continuous analysis. Numerical experiments in one and two space dimensions validate the designed order of accuracy and demonstrate stable performance for problems wit
items.title_zh: 可压缩反应流方程的斜对称公式和能量稳定方案
items.excerpt_zh: 本文为反应式欧拉方程和反应式纳维-斯托克斯方程开发了斜对称公式和能量稳定有限差分格式。通过引入合适的变换变量，我们将控制方程重写为斜对称形式，并通过标准的分部积分参数获得连续能量估计。所提出的公式将可压缩流动方程的斜对称框架扩展到反应系统，其中化学能和物质方程必须纳入转换变量中。基于这些公式，我们使用分部求和（SBP）运算符构建半离散方案。对流项由线性迎风SBP算子的非耗散部分离散化，而非线性SBP--WENO算子仅用于在不连续点附近提供人工耗散。对于周期性边界条件，所得方案满足与连续分析一致的半离散能量估计。一维和二维空间维度的数值实验验证了设计的精度顺序，并证明了解决问题的稳定性能

items.title: Analysis and approximation for inverse potential problem of space-dependent variable-exponent sub-diffusion in heterogeneous medium
items.excerpt: Anomalous transport in complex heterogeneous medium is often characterized by non-Markovian memory effects and spatially varying trapping properties. From the point of view of continuous-time random walks, such heterogeneity can be described by a position-dependent heavy-tailed waiting-time density $q(t \mid x)\sim C(x)t^{-1-\alpha(x)}$, where $0<\alpha(x)<1$ is the local anomalous exponent. This microscopic interpretation naturally leads to the sub-diffusion with a space-dependent variable exponent $\alpha(x)$. Compared with constant-exponent models, the variable-exponent fractional operators generally do not commute with the spatial Laplacian, which makes both the forward and inverse analysis substantially more delicate. This paper investigates the inverse problem of recovering a spatially dependent radiative or potential coefficient in variable-exponent sub-diffusion from terminal observation data. We formulate the inverse problem as a nonlinear fixed-point equation and prove that the associated fixed-point operator is monotone such that the fixed-point iteration converges decreasingly to the unique solution. We further establish a

items.title: Numerical Analysis for a Nonlinear Coupled Thermoelastic System with Acoustic Boundary Conditions
items.excerpt: This paper presents the first $L^2$-norm error analysis for a nonlinear thermoelastic system with acoustic boundary conditions. The model involves three coupled variables: the acoustic potential $u$, the temperature $\theta$, and the normal displacement to the boundary $\delta$, with nonlinearities $|u|^d u$ in the domain and $g(\cdot,u')$ on the boundary, in addition to a nonlocal term $\beta(\int_\Omega\theta dx)\Delta\theta$ in the heat equation. We establish error estimates for the fully discrete problem, using the Crank-Nicolson method for time discretization and finite element method with basis of degree $r \geqslant 1$ for space discretization. We demonstrate that the domain-boundary coupling induces a half-power loss in the spatial convergence order for the variable $u$, and this effect propagates to the remaining variables due to the thermoelastic and boundary couplings, resulting in the final error estimate $\mathcal{O}(h^{r+\frac{1}{2}} + \tau^2)$. A bootstrap argument is employed to ensure the uniform boundedness of $\|U_h^n\|_{L^\infty}$, which is essential for handling the nonlinearity. Numerical results using Lagrange f

items.title: A Kleene-inspired sequent system for a minimal logic of evidence and truth
items.excerpt: This paper investigates the proof theory of the logic of evidence and truth LETFm, with the aim of obtaining a sequent calculus consisting only of logical rules, suitable for a simple bottom-up decision procedure. We begin with G1f, a sequent system containing structural rules, which makes explicit the main difficulties in obtaining a fully logical and decidable calculus for LETFm. We then introduce G3f, a G3-style system obtained from by applying Kleene's trick, which absorbs contraction into the logical rules by adding the principal formula of the rule to its premises.
items.title_zh: 受 Kleene 启发的顺序系统，用于证据和真相的最小逻辑

items.title: Weakly uniform computable categoricity and function composition
items.excerpt: We introduce the definition of a weakly $X$-uniformly $Y$-computably categorical structure, relativizing a definition of Kudinov (1996), and show that this relativized notion is closely related to the 2-dimensional complexity of the pairs of partial functions $(f,g)$ with the property that the composition $g\circ f$ simulates convergent $\emptyset'$-oracle computations. We develop a general theory for computing via composition and use it to prove results about the surprisingly complex weakly uniform categoricity spectrum of the structure $(\omega,S)$ where $S(n)=n+1$. Namely, that $(\omega,S)$ is w.$X$.u.$Y$.c.c. for some $X\not\geq_T\emptyset'$ and $Y<_T\emptyset'$, but $(\omega,S)$ is not w.$X$.u.$Y$.c.c. for any $X<_T\emptyset'$ and $Y\not\geq_T\emptyset'$. We also construct a computably categorical structure that is not w.$\emptyset'$.u.c.c., but is w.$X$.u.c.c. for a set $X$ that is $\leq_T$-incomparable with $\emptyset'$.

items.title: Short proof that Vop\v{e}nka's Principle is symmetrically stable
items.excerpt: We show that Vop\v{e}nka's Principle is stable under symmetric extensions. Recently, de Groot and Woloszyn [1] proved this fact. We found the proof of this theorem unnecessarily complicated. In this short note we prove the same statement. We direct the reader to [3] for an exposition on symmetric extensions.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了 Vop\v{e}nka 原理在对称扩展下是稳定的。最近，de Groot 和 Woloszyn [1] 证明了这一事实。我们发现这个定理的证明不必要地复杂。在这篇简短的文章中，我们证明了同样的说法。我们引导读者参考 [3] 来了解对称扩展。

items.title: The pattern of consistency strength for membership in a computably enumerable set
items.excerpt: Every computable preorder relation on the natural numbers is the order of consistency strength for the membership assertions "$n\in A$" in some computably enumerable set $A$. Moreover, for every computably enumerable list of theories $T_0,T_1,T_2,\ldots$, each extending PA, there is a computably enumerable set $A$ such that each $T_n$ is equiconsistent over PA with the membership assertion $n\in A$. And similarly for both results when using instead the nonmembership assertions $n\notin A$.

items.excerpt_zh: 自然数上的每个可计算先序关系都是某个可计算可枚举集 $A$ 中的成员资格断言“$n\in A$”的一致性强度的顺序。此外，对于每个可计算可枚举理论列表 $T_0,T_1,T_2,\ldots$，每个扩展 PA，都有一个可计算可枚举集合 $A$，使得每个 $T_n$ 在 PA 上与 A$ 中的成员资格断言 $n\in 等一致。当使用非成员资格断言 $n\notin A$ 时，这两个结果也类似。

items.title: Equivalence of Restricted and Full Division
items.excerpt: We prove over $\mathrm{PA}^{-}$ that the restricted Euclidean division principle $\mathrm{pa17}^{-}$, which asserts division only for co-prime pairs, is equivalent to the full principle $\mathrm{pa17}$. The proof uses a transformation that preserves the quotient in division with remainder to reduce an arbitrary division problem to one for a co-prime pair. This answers Visser's Open Question 8.29 and shows that the restricted principle has the same strength as full Euclidean division over $\mathrm{PA}^{-}$.
items.title_zh: 限制除法和全除法的等价
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过 $\mathrm{PA}^{-}$ 证明，限制欧几里得除法原理 $\mathrm{pa17}^{-}$（仅对互素对进行除法）等价于完整原理 $\mathrm{pa17}$。该证明使用一种变换，保留除法中的商与余数，以将互素对的任意除法问题简化为一个。这回答了 Visser 的开放问题 8.29，并表明限制原理与 $\mathrm{PA}^{-}$ 上的完整欧几里得除法具有相同的强度。

items.title: A sound pure type system with ranks as sorts and Type-in-Type
items.excerpt: We present a dependently typed pure type system that contains a circular axiom $s : s$ for a certain sort $s$ and is nonetheless strongly normalizing. Girard's paradox is avoided because our sorts are not closed under a $\Pi$-former: function types are placed in sorts according to their rank. Turns out that this system has a unique set of characteristics: it has similar normalization behaviour as STLC (so complexity of normalization is TOWER-complete) while at the same time allowing non-uniform representation of arbitrary elementary recursive functions; furthermore, it has a nontrivial set-theoretical model in ZF+GCH and allows to carry out nontrivial proof developments. Base normalization proof is surprisingly simple (modulo general metatheoretical properties of pure type systems) and has been fully formalized in vanilla Rocq (formerly Coq) without additional axioms.
items.title_zh: 一个健全的纯类型系统，具有排序和类型输入
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一个依赖类型的纯类型系统，它包含一个循环公理 $s : s$ 对于某种类型 $s$ 并且仍然是强规范化的。避免了吉拉德悖论，因为我们的排序不是在 $\Pi$-former 下封闭的：函数类型根据其等级进行排序。事实证明，该系统具有一组独特的特征：它具有与 STLC 类似的归一化行为（因此归一化的复杂性是 TOWER-complete），同时允许任意基本递归函数的非均匀表示；此外，它在 ZF+GCH 中具有非平凡的集合论模型，并允许进行非平凡的证明开发。基本规范化证明非常简单（纯类型系统的模一般元理论属性），并且已在 vanilla Rocq（以前称为 Coq）中完全形式化，无需额外的公理。

items.title: Identity crisis on tightly $C^{(2)}$-compact cardinals
items.excerpt: Bagaria and Goldberg asked if $\kappa$ being tightly $C^{(n)}$-compact implies $\kappa\in C^{(n+1)}$ for natural numbers $n\ge 1$? Usuba gave a negative answer for $n=1$. In this paper we give a negative answer for $n=2$.
items.title_zh: 紧密 $C^{(2)}$ 紧凑基数上的身份危机
items.excerpt_zh: Bagaria 和 Goldberg 问，对于自然数 $n\ge 1$，$\kappa$ 是否紧密 $C^{(n)}$ 紧凑意味着 $\kappa\in C^{(n+1)}$ ？ Usuba 对 $n=1$ 给出了否定答案。在本文中，我们对 $n=2$ 给出否定答案。

items.title: Doing Less with More: A First-Principles Exploration of the Suitability of Agentic Computing over Alternative Architectural Choices
items.excerpt: There is growing interest in automating business activities with Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) due to latter's seeming ease of use. Never has it been easier, or costlier, to do less with more. However, little is known about when agents are preferable to established alternatives such as local computation, Representational State Transfer (REST), the Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), particularly when development speed, performance, and operational cost are considered. We investigate this question using a controlled mathematical task that compares seven methods on a benchmark of 1,000 arithmetic expressions where semantics of operator precedence has to be preserved. We ran this setup across a native Function Calling baseline (Python library), REST, SOAP and MCP microservice architectures, direct responses from large language models (LLMs) using a Groq cloud API and five locally deployed Ollama models, and agentic systems in which five local LLMs invoke MCP tools. items.title_zh: 事半功倍：代理计算相对于替代架构选择的适用性的第一性原理探索
items.excerpt_zh: 由于代理人工智能 (AI) 看似易于使用，因此人们对利用代理人工智能 (AI) 实现业务活动自动化越来越感兴趣。花更多的钱做更少的事情从未如此简单或成本更高。然而，人们对代理何时优于本地计算、表述性状态传输 (REST)、简单对象访问协议 (SOAP) 和模型上下文协议 (MCP) 等已建立的替代方案知之甚少，特别是在考虑开发速度、性能和运营成本时。我们使用受控数学任务来研究这个问题，该任务在 1,000 个算术表达式的基准上比较七种方法，其中必须保留运算符优先级的语义。我们在本机函数调用基线（Python 库）、REST、SOAP 和 MCP 微服务架构、使用 Groq 云 API 和五个本地部署的 Ollama 模型的大型语言模型 (LLM) 的直接响应，以及五个本地 LLM 调用 MCP 工具的代理系统中运行此设置。确定性方法可实现 100% 的准确度，并且延迟可以忽略不计。直接 LLM 评估的准确率最高可达 92.9%

items.title: Unified Multiparadigm Fusion Intelligence for Rare Disease Diagnosis
items.excerpt: Rare diseases (RDs) affect an estimated 300 million people globally, leaving patients to navigate a protracted diagnostic odyssey constrained by clinical scarcity and fragmented medical knowledge. Artificial intelligence (AI) has progressively advanced RD diagnostics, from symbolic methods and deep learning to large language model (LLM)-based systems. However, each paradigm carries structural limitations: symbolic methods are bounded by knowledge completeness, neural models sacrifice interpretability, and LLM-based systems are vulnerable to evaluation biases like data leakage. In this study, we introduce FusionRare, a unified multiparadigm fusion framework integrating knowledge-driven symbolic reasoning, deep-learning pattern recognition, case-based patient retrieval, and LLM-based heuristic inference via statistical meta-aggregation and knowledge-enhanced agentic reflection. Evaluated on 2,528 strictly isolated clinical cases, FusionRare achieves state-of-the-art RD prioritization, attaining a macro-averaged Recall @1 of 51% for phenotype-only diagnosis and 79% for phenotype-genotype joint analysis. items.title: LogicVal:A Logic-Formalized Benchmark for Constraint Satisfaction in Text-to-Image Generation
items.excerpt: Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have made significant progress in producing high-fidelity images from natural-language prompts. Alongside this progress, numerous benchmarks have been developed to evaluate capabilities such as attribute binding, numeracy, spatial reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. In this work, we propose a new perspective on T2I evaluation by casting it as a constraint-satisfaction problem. We introduce a logical framework that formally specifies the benchmark domain, including objects, attributes, and relations, alongside the constraints that generated images must satisfy. We evaluated four state-of-the-art T2I models across 9 classes of constraints ranging from a single-object-attribute to multi-object relationships constraints involving logical operators ($\forall, \exists, count, \rightarrow$). Our results reveal a substantial gap between single-object and complex conditional multi-object relationship constraint classes, with the best-performing model achieving 98% accuracy on the former and just 53% on the latter. items.title: A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt
items.excerpt: We ask how much an autoregressive transformer retains of its prompt after generating $t$ tokens. Consider two different prompts followed by the same continuation text, so that any difference in their hidden states comes from the prompt alone, and we find that the distance between their hidden states decays approximately as a power law $t^{-\alpha}$, where $\alpha=1$ is the rate at which a fixed prompt's share of uniform attention shrinks and smaller values mean longer memory. Trained models forget fast ($\alpha\approx0.55$--$0.7$), untrained ones slowly ($\alpha\approx0.2$--$0.5$). We prove that this offset is $O\big(P(\log t)^{L-1}/t\big)$ for a prompt of length $P$ and depth $L$. The bound holds for finite-depth pre-LN softmax transformers with bounded attention logits, under one additional condition: the pre-norm activations stay away from zero. The mechanism is geometric: the prompt's direct influence is diluted as the context grows, and \emph{relay} --- continuation tokens passing on what earlier tokens read from the prompt --- can only add logarithmic factors. items.title: Training-Free Prompt Selection for Efficient Reinforcement Learning With Partial Rollouts
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for training reasoning models, but its computational cost makes efficient data selection increasingly important. Since training examples contribute unequally to learning, selecting a small, informative subset can offer a more efficient alternative to using the entire data pool. The training-free selection method estimates prompt value with hidden states from complete greedy rollouts. However, in our datasets, $26$--$32\%$ of these rollouts fail to terminate within the generation budget. We introduce LIFT, a training-free data selector that identifies impactful prompts using only partial reasoning rollouts. At its core, LIFT uses Partial Rollout Context Lift (PRCL), a score inspired by pointwise $\mathcal{V}$-information that accumulates token-level log-likelihood ratios between a question-conditioned context and a null context with the question removed. items.title: Cortex: A Fixed-Point Theory of Governed Coding Agents - Technical Report
items.excerpt: A coding agent combines a large language model (LLM) with a harness that plans, edits, and executes code. We study Cortex, a supervisory layer for pre-execution governance, requirement tracking, and iterative validation and repair. We formalize requirement closure on a finite lattice. For a fixed requirement set and a sound, monotone validation rule with persistent evidence, exhaustive iteration reaches the least fixed point with no more strict increases than there are requirements. Fair consequence scheduling reaches the same closure. A separate stochastic model bounds expected completion time under a uniform positive-progress assumption. These results depend on their stated assumptions; artifact repair, fallible validation, and finite execution budgets do not satisfy them automatically. We define Gauntlet's trajectory-similarity and build-gated scores, attack-success estimators, Wilson intervals, and case-cluster bootstrap summaries. Effective-feedback accounting counts newly certified requirements, rather than estimating their information value or utility. The five evaluation families support raw-versus-governed comparisons. items.title: Who Speaks, Who Authorizes, Who Acts? Understanding Trust Boundaries in Multi-Agent LLMs
items.excerpt: Multi-agent LLM systems exchange messages before acting through tools, but message delivery, signing authority, and tool-side enforcement are separate trust boundaries. We represent them as communication, authorization, and execution structures, and use the authority cut to characterize the smallest independently compromised signer coalition that can construct a policy-valid false-claim proof under stated assumptions. Controlled paired hidden-state studies reveal four distinctions. First, no fixed-message routing contrast across four models meets the prespecified large-effect criterion; when relays rewrite messages, executed false-state action rates vary by model and route configuration. Second, presented source-identity cues do not uniformly increase protected-action selection across three models. Third, on invalid-proof cases, Nemotron and Llama request protected actions in 52.1% and 54.2% of trials, respectively, yet a deterministic tool gate commits none: request-level and commitment-level safety readouts diverge. items.title: CME-SpectrumBench: Can LLMs Analyze Condensed Matter Spectral Data?
items.excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) are presently well assessed by expert-level mathematics and physics benchmarks which focus on theoretical, symbolic reasoning. However, we lack experimental benchmarks that evaluate data analysis in frontier research problems, a capability that future domain-specific foundation models must have. To this end, we present CME-SpectrumBench, an expert-designed benchmark consisting of 190 questions that measures how reliably frontier LLMs analyze research-level spectral scientific data in condensed matter experiments (CME). Using simulated CME spectral data, we prompt models to identify structures from 2D intensity arrays in the face of noise and limited instrumental resolution, a test of dense context reasoning. Models are scored by how accurately their numerical answers approach the ground truth. Under direct query, scores generally pale in comparison to handwritten code due to clear failure modes: models can find simple features but struggle to trace patterns or compute derived quantities, and performance typically degrades with increased data resolution and noise/convolution levels. items.excerpt_zh: 目前，大型语言模型 (LLM) 通过专家级数学和物理基准进行了很好的评估，这些基准侧重于理论和符号推理。然而，我们缺乏评估前沿研究问题中的数据分析的实验基准，而这是未来特定领域基础模型必须具备的能力。为此，我们推出了 CME-SpectrumBench，这是一个专家设计的基准，由 190 个问题组成，用于衡量前沿法学硕士在凝聚态实验 (CME) 中分析研究级光谱科学数据的可靠性。使用模拟的 CME 光谱数据，我们提示模型在面对噪声和有限的仪器分辨率时从 2D 强度阵列中识别结构，这是对密集上下文推理的测试。模型的评分标准是其数值答案接近真实情况的准确程度。在直接查询下，由于明显的故障模式，与手写代码相比，分数通常显得苍白：模型可以找到简单的特征，但很难跟踪模式或计算派生量，并且性能通常会随着数据分辨率和噪声/卷积级别的增加而下降。 LLM 表现变为

items.title: How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies
items.excerpt: Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textit{tasks}, \textit{environments}, and \textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this question end-to-end with three tightly coupled contributions. First, we decompose agentic data into three cardinality axes (task, environment, trajectory), plus a reward-density control variable, and fit per-axis scaling relations on different large language models (LLMs) across math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool application domains. Across all model sizes, model families, domains, and RL algorithms (PPO and GRPO) we measured, the scaling exponents order as environment $>$ task $>$ trajectory. items.title_zh: 代理强化学习中的数据如何扩展：法则和综合策略
items.excerpt_zh: 预训练缩放法则将训练数据视为一维数量：令牌计数。代理强化学习（RL）继承了这种标量抽象，但现代综合管道现在以非常不同的成本独立生成 \textit{tasks}、\textit{environments} 和 \textit{trajectories}，将数据转换为结构化设计空间。这就提出了一个预训练从来不需要回答的问题：给定综合预算，\textit{哪个轴}应该缩放？我们通过三个紧密耦合的贡献来端到端地解决这个问题。首先，我们将代理数据分解为三个基数轴（任务、环境、轨迹），加上奖励密度控制变量，并在跨数学+代码、SWE、Web 和 UI/工具应用程序域的不同大型语言模型 (LLM) 上拟合每轴缩放关系。在我们测量的所有模型大小、模型系列、领域和 RL 算法（PPO 和 GRPO）中，缩放指数顺序为环境 $>$ 任务 $>$ 轨迹。当环境多样性分解为世界多样性和环境结构多样性时，其优势主要由前者驱动，而后者只是由环境多样性驱动。

items.title: Continual Test-Time Learning with Evolution Strategies
items.excerpt: Large language models increasingly operate in open-ended environments, where they are expected to continually adapt to evolving tasks and distributions, often without access to external supervision. Existing continual learning approaches rely on external supervision, such as labeled data, demonstrations, or reward signals, which can be costly or unavailable in practice. Test-time adaptation removes this dependence by learning from self-generated supervision, but existing methods derive that supervision from the single policy being updated, so once the policy drifts, its own learning signal drifts with it, leading to policy collapse, degraded reasoning, and catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning (ESRL)}, a continual test-time learning framework that draws its self-generated supervision from a population of policies instead of the single policy being trained. ESRL perturbs an anchor policy in parameter space to form a population of nearby policies, samples one trajectory from each, and aggregates their answers into label-free group-relative learning signals for the central st
items.authors: Guangya Hao, Yiting Duan, Longyan Tan, Yunbo Long, Hao Wu, Ge Zheng, Alexandra Brintrup, Zhuokai Zhao
items.title_zh: 通过进化策略进行持续的测试时学习
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地在开放环境中运行，在这种环境中，它们需要不断适应不断变化的任务和分布，而通常不需要外部监督。现有的持续学习方法依赖于外部监督，例如标记数据、演示或奖励信号，这在实践中可能成本高昂或不可用。测试时适应通过从自我生成的监督中学习来消除这种依赖性，但现有的方法从正在更新的单个策略中获得监督，因此一旦策略发生变化，其自身的学习信号也会随之变化，从而导致策略崩溃、推理退化和灾难性遗忘。在本文中，我们提出了 \textbf{进化策略强化学习（ESRL）}，这是一种持续的测试时间学习框架，它从一组策略而不是单个正在训练的策略中获取自我生成的监督。 ESRL 扰乱参数空间中的锚定策略，以形成附近策略的群体，从每个策略中采样一个轨迹，并将其答案聚合成中央策略的无标签组相关学习信号。

items.title: Margin Certificates for Voting Classifiers under Mixing Dependence
items.excerpt: Margin bounds explain why weighted votes generalize after training error vanishes, but dependent observations require concentration arguments that keep the dependence model and failure budget explicit. We study stationary mixing streams without treating dependence as a formal substitution of an "effective sample size." For a finite base class, we combine independent-block Rademacher theory for stationary $\beta$-mixing processes with a clipped margin loss to obtain an explicit uniform voting-margin certificate, whose dependence penalty is set by the number of approximately independent blocks and the coupling budget $4(\mu-1)\beta(a)$. A black-box transfer theorem shows that any i.i.d. voting-margin guarantee remains valid on a regularly spaced subsequence, with only an additive $\beta$-mixing failure probability. For votes fixed independently of a stationary finite-state reversible Markov stream, spectral concentration gives the cleaner $\sqrt{t_{rel}/n}$ rate, and a sticky-refresh construction shows this exponent is unavoidable. items.title: Constructive Universal Approximation by Infinite-Dimensional Neural Networks via Gaussian-Weighted Ridgelet Transform
items.excerpt: Neural networks whose inputs are functions, as in operator learning, are usually shown to be universal by existence arguments, either by reduction to finite-dimensional networks or by Stone--Weierstrass-type density; these prove that approximants exist but say little about how the parameters depend on the target. We take a constructive route. We extend the ridgelet transform, an integral transform related to the Fourier, Radon, and wavelet transforms, to continuous maps on a separable infinite-dimensional Hilbert space, replacing the Lebesgue measure that is unavailable in infinite dimensions by Gaussian weights with a homogeneous mixture on the direction space. The resulting transform has a Plancherel identity and reconstruction formulas incorporating the frame operator, the correction induced by the weights, and it assigns to each target an explicit coefficient measure, one for every admissible analysis filter. items.title: Uniform convergence at optimal rate and scale
items.excerpt: Uniform convergence asks how many random samples suffice for empirical averages to approximate expectations simultaneously over an entire class of functions. It is a central concept in probability and a foundation of statistical learning. For binary-valued classes, the Vapnik--Chervonenkis theorem characterizes uniform convergence by finiteness of the VC dimension. For dimension $d$, the sharp worst-case sample complexity for additive error $\varepsilon$ is of order $d/\varepsilon^2$. For real-valued functions, the analogous combinatorial parameter is the fat-shattering dimension, which depends on an approximation scale $\gamma$. The challenge is to achieve error $\gamma+\varepsilon$ with order $d/\varepsilon^2$ samples, matching the sample bound for binary classes, where $d$ is now the fat-shattering dimension at scale $\gamma$. Previous results achieved either the optimal scale or the optimal sample complexity, but not both. Our main result closes this gap, establishing the sharp sample complexity at the optimal scale. items.title: Measuring Empowerment from Offline Data for Intrinsically Motivated Exploration
items.excerpt: Large, unlabeled datasets of prior experience have become increasingly available for agentic tasks in domains such as robotics and coding. A common recipe for these tasks is to train a policy using the prior data, and then further improve it with online rollouts. But while much work has studied how to use both the offline and online data for policy extraction, far less work has been done to understand how the prior data can be used to efficiently \textit{explore} during the online learning phase. Previous work has attempted to formalize this idea by defining the \textit{empowerment}, a measure of how many future states an agent can realize; states with higher empowerment require more exploration as there are more futures to explore. However, existing methods for estimating empowerment require online policy rollouts in the environment. We propose the first method for estimating empowerment from unlabeled prior data, without any environment interaction. items.authors: Ishir Garg, Vivek Myers, Qiyang Li, Catherine Ji, Benjamin Eysenbach, Sergey Levine
items.title_zh: 衡量离线数据对内在驱动探索的授权
items.excerpt_zh: 先前经验的大型未标记数据集越来越多地可用于机器人和编码等领域的代理任务。这些任务的常见方法是使用先前的数据训练策略，然后通过在线部署进一步改进它。但是，虽然很多工作都在研究如何使用离线和在线数据进行策略提取，但在理解在线学习阶段如何使用先验数据有效地\textit{explore}方面所做的工作却少之又少。之前的工作试图通过定义 \textit{empowerment} 来形式化这个想法，这是一个衡量智能体可以实现多少种未来状态的指标；权力较高的国家需要更多的探索，因为有更多的未来可供探索。然而，现有的评估赋权的方法需要在环境中在线推出政策。我们提出了第一种方法，用于根据未标记的先验数据来估计赋权，而无需任何环境交互。通过共同学习赋权最大化策略及其折扣状态占用度量，我们的估计器可以接受由任何未知数生成的未标记轨迹的训练。

items.title: No-Regret Revenue Maximization in Sequential Market Making Under Inventory Constraints
items.excerpt: Market makers keep trading efficient by setting bid and ask prices for buyers and sellers. In sequential market making, trades happen independently based on price thresholds, requiring the market maker to maintain balanced, low-risk inventory over T rounds. This paper studies how to maximize revenue with unknown buyer and seller valuations using regret minimization. When the market maker only sees trade success or failure, an algorithm achieves regret and inventory bounds proportional to T to the power of 2/3. When full order book data is available for failed trades, regret and inventory limits improve significantly to the square root of T. We also establish a fundamental trade-off via a lower bound, by proving that tighter round-by-round inventory limits strictly force higher minimum regret.
items.authors: Davide Maran, Marcello Restelli, Francesco Emanuele Stradi
items.title_zh: 库存限制下连续做市的无悔收入最大化
items.excerpt_zh: 做市商通过为买家和卖家设定出价和要价来保持交易效率。在顺序做市中，交易根据价格阈值独立发生，要求做市商在 T 轮中保持平衡、低风险的库存。本文研究了如何使用后悔最小化在未知的买家和卖家估值的情况下最大化收入。当做市商只看到交易成功或失败时，算法会实现遗憾，库存范围与 T 的 2/3 次方成正比。当失败交易的完整订单簿数据可用时，遗憾和库存限制将显着改善至 T 的平方根。我们还通过下限建立基本权衡，证明更严格的逐轮库存限制严格迫使更高的最小遗憾。

items.title: Reasoning with Context Management and External Memory
items.excerpt: Reasoning models maintain information about the status of their reasoning process through in-context memory. Complex problems require larger context windows and memory requirements. In this scenario, context management without caching risks discarding useful information for reasoning. We propose RCMEM, an approach that extends context management with an external memory to maintain additional information without burdening the reasoning model with additional context. RCMEM significantly reduces computation time on problems that require repeated computation of intermediate steps, while achieving better performance on complex problems. We demonstrate our approach on a few mathematics problems using model sizes ranging from 0.4 to 25 million parameters, and GPT-2.
items.authors: Man-Ling Sung, William Hartmann, Jiangying Zhou

items.title: Preserving Reasoning Diversity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards via Adaptive Replay
items.excerpt: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but often reduces the diversity of their reasoning behaviors. We study this phenomenon from the perspective of finite-sample learning dynamics and show that limited on-policy rollouts can progressively suppress semantically distinct but equally rewarded reasoning modes. Once a mode becomes sufficiently under-sampled, standard on-policy RLVR rarely recovers it. Motivated by this observation, we propose TAR, a Targeted Adaptive Replay framework that preserves diverse correct reasoning behaviors already present in the base policy. TAR constructs a compact memory bank of diverse base-model solutions and selectively replays them through an adaptive mechanism that activates only when stored behaviors are being suppressed during RLVR. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two Qwen2.5 model scales, TAR consistently achieves a better balance between reasoning performance and diversity preservation than existing diversity-preserving post-training methods, while substantially reducing the forgetting of correct base-model
items.authors: Wen-Zhi Li, Sainyam Galhotra, Claire Cardie

items.title: From Stories to Features: Scaling Concept Vectors for AI Alignment & Interpretability
items.excerpt: We study feature vectors: directions in a language model's activation space that correspond to human-interpretable concepts, such as honesty or deception. Existing unsupervised methods like sparse autoencoders attempt to recover the whole feature space, often at the cost of feature quality and interpretability. We take a more pragmatic route: focusing on concepts relevant to AI safety and alignment, we generate synthetic concept-antagonist story pairs and use the difference of their mean model activations as a feature vector. We scale this approach to 1,036 alignment-relevant concepts using 2M synthetic stories across multiple languages and genres, which we publicly release. Across six models from three model families, our feature vectors reliably generalize to detecting their corresponding concepts in chat dialogues and web text. They form an interpretable geometry shared across models and can causally steer model behavior when injected into activations. items.title: Training with Ciphers to Enhance In-Context Terminology Learning For Translation from Rare Languages
items.excerpt: Fine-tuning LLMs with in-context examples (IC-Train) lets translation models adapt to new parallel data at deployment, but it is unclear whether they actually learn the translations of rare terms from those examples. We formalize this capability as in-context term learning (ICTL). We show that standard IC-Train develops this capability only weakly, and propose RareCipherFT, which strengthens it without any lexical resources. RareCipherFT pairs each training target with in-context examples that share a rare term with it. It then replaces that term with a character-shuffled cipher in both the context and the reference, so the term can only be recovered by copying from context. The ciphered fraction of training data is annealed to preserve translation quality. Across seven translation directions between English and Tamil, Assamese, Mizo, Nepali and Hausa, and four models from 1B to 7B parameters, RareCipherFT raises term recall over standard IC-Train by 5-15 absolute points without lowering COMET. items.title: What RL Brings to Reasoning: A Few Decisions the Base Model Would Not Make
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) substantially improves mathematical reasoning, but what it adds to the base model remains unclear. We investigate this through a sequence of generation-time interventions on Qwen3-4B-Base, measuring how much of its RL-trained counterpart's gain each intervention recovers on 120 AIME problems. Power sampling with the same 8,192-token output limit brings no gain beyond greedy decoding. Yet borrowing the RL model's token only where the two models' greedy choices differ, roughly 4% of generated positions, recovers 90.5% of the pass@1 gain, with similar recovery across three model pairs on MATH-500. We find that even a single opening token has a substantial effect: forcing the base model to begin with "Alright" recovers 35% of the RL gain. The opening alone is insufficient, however. Later replacements after the same opening add another 5.2 percentage points to pass@1, and the fixed rules we test for inserting reflective words such as "Wait" do not reproduce this benefit. items.title: BanglaBBQ: A Bias Benchmark for Question Answering in the Bangladeshi Context
items.excerpt: This paper introduces BanglaBBQ, a question-answering bias benchmark designed to capture stereotypes grounded in the Bangladeshi context, in both Bangla and English. Following KoBBQ and PakBBQ, BanglaBBQ adapts the original Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ) by classifying its templates into three groups: directly translated (DT), modified to align target groups or contexts with Bangladesh (TM), and removed when deemed unsuitable for the Bangladeshi context (SR). This process retains 140 templates across six categories, comprising 76 DT and 64 TM templates. Five newly authored (NA) categories, based on stereotypes common in Bangladeshi society, are then added: marital status, age and political perception, regional origin, educational background, and mental-health status. Native Bangladeshi annotators judged all 466 newly authored templates, and 372 were retained because a strict majority of English annotators identified the intended target and rated the attitude as common enough. items.title: How Well Can LLMs Verbalize Mathematical Formulas? A Multi-Domain Evaluation
items.excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across natural language tasks. But their ability to generate accurate written verbalizations of mathematical formulas has not been systematically evaluated. Such verbalization is important for text-to-speech systems supporting audio-based learning and visually impaired users. We evaluated five state-of-the-art LLMs across six scientific domains and constructed Read-Aloud Math, a balanced multi-domain corpus with LaTeX formulas, manually validated simple and extended transcriptions, multiple variants, textual context, domain labels, and formula complexity levels. Using multi-reference BLEU, GPT-5.2 achieved the highest score for simple transcriptions (75.9% without context, 64.9% with context), although without context it did not significantly outperform Grok 4.1 Fast or Claude Sonnet 4.5. Claude Sonnet 4.5 achieved the highest score for extended transcriptions without context (36.5%), and Grok 4.1 Fast with context (48.8%).
