items.title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
items.excerpt: We present \'{E}pi, an autonomous research agent that sustains investigations across model sessions and evolves its methods through accumulated experience. \'{E}pi combines persistent research history, hierarchical memory, branching and independent review to maintain research continuity, learn from experiments, and explore and revisit alternative approaches. Its experiments run across session boundaries, and a fixed verifier evaluates their outputs. \'{E}pi produced 120 record-setting results, comprising 20 numerical bound records across 12 families and 100 construction records across eight families. These include an approximately 84-fold narrower interval for the $n$-queens constant and a more than 3.6-million-fold narrower rigorous interval for the quartic Feigenbaum attractor dimension. Exact dual certificates establish that the Cohn-Elkies linear-programming bound cannot be sharp in dimensions 10 and 11. Beyond numerical improvements, \'{E}pi gives a computer-assisted proof of Tuza's conjecture for split graphs with an eight-vertex clique part and at most three triangle-active neighborhood types, with arbitrary multiplicities. items.title: AI Proved the Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis. What Happens Now?
items.excerpt: Unlike other recent AI proofs, this one has been unpacked by human experts. The implications, one mathematician said, are “staggering.” The post AI Proved the Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis. What Happens Now? first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.title_zh: 人工智能证明了拟黎曼假设。现在发生了什么？
items.excerpt_zh: 与最近的其他人工智能证明不同，这个证明是由人类专家解开的。一位数学家表示，其影响“令人震惊”。后人工智能证明了拟黎曼猜想。现在发生了什么？首次出现在广达杂志上

items.title: Recommendations on the use of AI for PhD students and supervisors
items.excerpt: We provide a proposed set of guidelines for PhD students and their supervisors. Given that PhD students are the most affected, both professionally and psychologically, by the advent of AI in mathematics, such guidelines, even if they may soon be obsolete, could be useful to them, their advisors and graduate schools.
items.title_zh: 对博士生和导师使用人工智能的建议
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为博士生及其导师提供了一套拟议的指南。鉴于博士生在数学领域人工智能的出现在专业和心理上受到的影响最大，因此此类指南即使可能很快就会过时，但可能对他们、他们的导师和研究生院有用。

items.title: Contribution, Credit, and Community
items.excerpt: “This note is based on the assumption that the adoption of AI in mathematics is already inevitable. To paraphrase the principle of Chekhov’s gun, if we strive to resolve a conjecture while inhabiting a world that contains a button that, if pressed, will promptly resolve said conjecture, someone will indeed press the button. […]”
items.title_zh: 贡献、信用和社区
items.excerpt_zh: “这篇文章基于这样的假设，即人工智能在数学中的采用已经是不可避免的。套用契诃夫之枪的原理，如果我们努力解决一个猜想，同时居住在一个包含按钮的世界，如果按下该按钮，将立即解决所述猜想，那么有人确实会按下按钮。[...]”

items.title: Thinking Hard Above AI
items.excerpt: There are many ways in which AI is generating uncertainty in mathematics. We are not sure how it will impact our jobs, it is raising questions about how it might affect academic training, and it is not clear how it might change the job search process and how we evaluate research. This is by no means an exhaustive list. In this post, I will focus two another related questions, which are: “Is there still any mathematics to be done? And will doing mathematics still be fun and interesting?” I believe that there is, and here I set out to explain why.
items.title_zh: 认真思考超越人工智能
items.excerpt_zh: 人工智能通过多种方式在数学中产生不确定性。我们不确定它将如何影响我们的工作，它引发了关于它可能如何影响学术培训的问题，也不清楚它会如何改变求职过程以及我们如何评估研究。这绝不是一份详尽的清单。在这篇文章中，我将重点关注另外两个相关问题，即：“还有数学要做吗？做数学还会有趣吗？”我相信是有的，在这里我将解释原因。

items.title: A technical note on universal formula pcas
items.excerpt: We record some interesting technical caveats found when using universal formulae to formulate pcas -- namely, that there are different ways to extract a (partial) function from a definable collection of pairs, and these choices have an impact on formula complexity.
items.title_zh: 关于通用公式 pcas 的技术说明
items.excerpt_zh: 我们记录了在使用通用公式来制定 pcas 时发现的一些有趣的技术警告——即，有不同的方法可以从可定义的对集合中提取（部分）函数，并且这些选择会对公式复杂性产生影响。

items.title: The Compactness Theorem for Enriched Logic
items.excerpt: The framework of enriched logic extends positive logic (also known as coherent logic) from sets to structures internal to a symmetric monoidal closed category $\mathcal{V}$. This framework was developed by Rosick\'y and the second-named author. The main novelty of this logic is that the arities of the function and relation symbols are now objects in $\mathcal{V}$. We prove the compactness theorem for this enriched logic. That is, a set of $\mathcal{V}$-enriched sequents has a model (internal to $\mathcal{V}$) if every finite subset has a model. To achieve this, we define ultraproducts of enriched structures and prove enriched versions of {\L}os' theorem. We then develop some model-theoretic applications. We start with an enriched version of the model-theoretic method of diagrams, establishing a correspondence between homomorphisms whose domain is some enriched structure $A$ and models of the set $\operatorname{Diag}(A)$ of all enriched atomic formulas with parameters from $A$ that are true in $A$. Combining this with our compactness theorem, we prove amalgamation results, laying the foundations for enriched syntactic types (in the mod
items.title_zh: 丰富逻辑的紧致性定理
items.excerpt_zh: 丰富逻辑的框架将正逻辑（也称为相干逻辑）从集合扩展到对称幺半群封闭范畴 $\mathcal{V}$ 内部的结构。该框架由 Rosick'y 和第二作者开发。这种逻辑的主要新颖之处在于函数和关系符号的元数现在是 $\mathcal{V}$ 中的对象。我们证明了这种丰富逻辑的紧致性定理。也就是说，如果每个有限子集都有一个模型，则一组 $\mathcal{V}$ 丰富的序列就有一个模型（$\mathcal{V}$ 的内部）。为了实现这一目标，我们定义了丰富结构的超积并证明了 {\L}os 定理的丰富版本。然后我们开发一些模型理论应用程序。我们从图的模型理论方法的丰富版本开始，在域为某个丰富结构 $A$ 的同态与所有丰富原子公式的集合 $\operatorname{Diag}(A)$ 模型之间建立对应关系，其中参数来自 $A$，且在 $A$ 中为真。将此与我们的紧致性定理相结合，我们证明了合并结果，为丰富的句法类型奠定了基础（在 mod

items.title: Models of Arbitrary Sets
items.excerpt: There is a growing literature on arbitrary objects as other types of mathematical objects, besides particular mathematical objects. In this paper we study arbitrary sets in the context of ZFC set theory. An arbitrary object is one that is determined by a state space across which it varies and by its instantiations. We compare two semantic strategies. First, we analyse the possibility of modeling arbitrary sets using direct powers of a ZFC structure. This yields a natural setting, but one where Extensionality and, crucially, the full Separation scheme fail. Second, we consider structures composed of arbitrary sets using a direct power construction evaluated in a Boolean-valued semantics. Within this setting, we develop the cumulative hierarchy of arbitrary sets, arbitrary ordinals, cardinals, and filtrations of the structure of arbitrary sets. The final section develops a combinatorial interpretation in terms of independent assignments across a fixed state space. Its connection with the iterative conception is then discussed.
items.authors: Santiago Jockwich, Giorgio Venturi, Pedro Yago
items.title_zh: 任意集模型
items.excerpt_zh: 除了特定的数学对象之外，关于任意对象和其他类型的数学对象的文献越来越多。在本文中，我们在 ZFC 集合论的背景下研究任意集合。任意对象是由其变化的状态空间及其实例化确定的对象。我们比较两种语义策略。首先，我们分析使用 ZFC 结构的直接幂对任意集建模的可能性。这产生了一种自然的设置，但外延性和最重要的是完整的分离方案失败了。其次，我们考虑使用以布尔值语义评估的直接幂构造由任意集合组成的结构。在此设置中，我们开发了任意集合、任意序数、基数的累积层次结构以及任意集合结构的过滤。最后一部分根据固定状态空间中的独立分配制定了组合解释。然后讨论它与迭代概念的联系。

items.title: Proof Perplexity: A Probabilistic Approach to Measuring non-triviality in Machine Generated Proofs
items.excerpt: In this article, we propose a benchmark to quantify the non-triviality and novelty of machine-generated mathematical proofs compared to existing literature. Our core methodology uses a probabilistic measure to evaluate the non-triviality of the underlying mathematical arguments in comparison to the current \texttt{MATHLIB} library. Finally, we apply this benchmark to the recent proof generated by Claude on the complex zeros of the Riemann zeta function to test for non-trivial steps.
items.title_zh: 证明困惑：衡量机器生成证明中非平凡性的概率方法
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个基准来量化机器生成的数学证明与现有文献相比的非平凡性和新颖性。我们的核心方法使用概率度量来评估与当前 \texttt{MATHLIB} 库相比的基础数学参数的非平凡性。最后，我们将此基准应用于 Claude 最近针对黎曼 zeta 函数的复零点生成的证明，以测试非平凡的步骤。

items.title: A generalised and modular proof-theoretic semantics for sequent systems
items.excerpt: Base-extension semantics explains logical consequence via derivability in atomic systems. Extending this approach across logics requires careful control of structural principles and contexts. We present a modular sequent-based framework in which support is indexed by multisets of atomic resources and the semantic clauses for connectives are guided by their left introduction rules. The framework separates additive from multiplicative behaviour and makes explicit the contributions of structural rules and restrictions on sequents. We establish soundness and completeness for classical and intuitionistic propositional logic and for multiplicative-additive fragments of classical and intuitionistic linear logic. We then investigate axiomatic extensions of intuitionistic logic through Jankov logic. Two classes of atomic bases yield sound and complete semantics. Completeness is proven using two novel and modular methods using simulation bases, one of which is constructive. These results provide a common semantic treatment of several logical systems while identifying the additional conditions needed to extend the framework beyond structural v
items.authors: Victor Barroso-Nascimento, Arghya Chakrabarty, Elaine Pimentel
items.title_zh: 序列系统的广义模块化证明理论语义
items.excerpt_zh: 基础扩展语义通过原子系统中的可导性来解释逻辑结果。跨逻辑扩展这种方法需要仔细控制结构原则和上下文。我们提出了一个基于模块化序列的框架，其中支持由原子资源的多集索引，连接词的语义子句由其左引入规则引导。该框架将加法行为与乘法行为分开，并明确了结构规则的贡献和对序列的限制。我们为经典和直觉命题逻辑以及经典和直觉线性逻辑的乘加片段建立了健全性和完整性。然后，我们通过扬可夫逻辑研究直觉逻辑的公理扩展。两类原子基础产生健全且完整的语义。使用模拟基础的两种新颖的模块化方法证明了完整性，其中一种是建设性的。这些结果提供了几个逻辑系统的通用语义处理，同时确定了将框架扩展到结构性 v 之外所需的附加条件。

items.title: Classification of bipartite observables I: stable and uniformly stable observables
items.excerpt: When two quantum systems are prepared independently and each is driven to an idealized limit, the expectation of a bipartite observable may depend on which system is idealized first. We call an observable stable when it does not. We show that stability is equivalent to two operational properties. First, every idealized preparation of one system can be simulated to arbitrary accuracy, uniformly over all probes, by finite mixtures of actual preparations, provided that the probing system is idealized first. Second, any two idealized preparations have a unique, symmetric independent product. Under a uniform form of stability, we prove, the number of preparations that $n$ adaptive probes can tell apart at a fixed margin is bounded by a polynomial in $n$, and responses can be learned with a bounded number of mistakes; otherwise, at some margin, protocols with $n$ probes tell apart $2^n$ preparations. The swap test, Hong--Ou--Mandel coincidences and discrete equality tests turn out to be uniformly stable, with bounds independent of the dimension, while order comparisons of discrete spectra unbounded above are unstable. The proofs rest on t
items.title_zh: 二部观测量的分类 I：稳定和一致稳定的观测量
items.excerpt_zh: 当两个量子系统独立准备并且每个系统都被驱动到理想化极限时，二分可观测量的期望可能取决于哪个系统首先被理想化。当可观察的不稳定时，我们称之为稳定。我们证明稳定性相当于两个操作属性。首先，只要首先对探测系统进行理想化，就可以通过实际制备物的有限混合，在所有探针上统一地模拟任意精度的系统的每个理想化制备物。其次，任何两种理想化制剂都具有独特的、对称的独立产物。我们证明，在统一的稳定性形式下，$n$ 自适应探针可以在固定范围内区分的准备数量受到 $n$ 中的多项式的限制，并且可以通过有限数量的错误来学习响应；否则，在一定程度上，具有 $n$ 探针的协议可以区分 $2^n$ 准备工作。交换检验、洪-欧-曼德尔符合和离散等式检验结果是一致稳定的，其界限与维数无关，而上面无界的离散谱的阶次比较是不稳定的。证据取决于t

items.title: MGE-PO: Entropy-Aware Credit Assignment for Mathematical Reasoning
items.excerpt: GRPO assigns the same group-relative advantage to equally rewarded responses within a question, leaving their generation uncertainty unused. We introduce MGE-PO, centered on four-quadrant (4Q) advantage shaping that combines verified correctness with rollout generation entropy. Correctness determines the sign of an additional correction, while entropy controls its magnitude: lower-entropy successes receive larger bonuses and higher-entropy failures receive larger penalties. An online entropy-based question curriculum supports this credit rule using cached rollout measurements. At the final checkpoint after eight training epochs on Qwen3-8B-Base, adding 4Q across three policy optimization settings yields absolute gains of 3.23-3.69% in six-benchmark macro avg@32 and 4.24-11.06% in macro pass@32. On Qwen2.5-7B-Base, the complete configuration raises four-benchmark macro avg@32 from 41.5% to 45.4%.
items.authors: Jihao Huang, Guangjia Chai, Zhirui Chen, Lei Wang, Yao Liu, Liu Qi, Pengjie Ding, Xinyang Liu, Chengxun Jia, Ling Shao, Hongyu Chen, Junchen Wan
items.title_zh: MGE-PO：数学推理的熵感知信用分配
items.excerpt_zh: GRPO 将相同的群体相对优势分配给问题中同等奖励的回答，而未使用其生成的不确定性。我们引入了 MGE-PO，以四象限 (4Q) 优势塑造为中心，将验证的正确性与推出生成熵相结合。正确性决定了额外修正的符号，而熵控制了其大小：较低熵的成功会获得更大的奖励，而较高熵的失败会受到更大的惩罚。基于熵的在线问题课程使用缓存的推出测量来支持此学分规则。在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上经过 8 个训练周期后的最后一个检查点，在三个策略优化设置中添加 4Q 会在六基准宏 avg@32 中产生 3.23-3.69% 的绝对增益，在宏 pass@32 中产生 4.24-11.06% 的绝对增益。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Base 上，完整的配置将四基准宏 avg@32 从 41.5% 提高到 45.4%。

items.title: Space-filling curves and small-ball probabilities for the Kloosterman process
items.excerpt: We construct explicitly a space-filling curve in the support of the limiting Kloosterman process, using the planar partial-sum curve of the Rudin--Shapiro sequence. The qualitative existence statement was previously attributed to J. Bober by Kowalski. The resulting curve is a closed, $1/2$-H\"older continuous loop whose image contains a specified triangle of area $1/128$. Its Fourier coefficients are purely imaginary and satisfy $|\widehat f(h)|\leq(2\pi|h|)^{-1}$ for $h\ne 0$. We also prove a uniform lower bound for small balls centred at closed $1/2$-H\"older curves with a fixed coefficient bound, of the form $\exp\{-C\varepsilon^{-2}\log^2(2/\varepsilon)\}$. Known functional convergence then gives a quantitative lower bound for the limiting proportion of two-parameter Kloosterman paths approximating the constructed loop.
items.title_zh: Kloosterman 过程的空间填充曲线和小球概率
items.excerpt_zh: 我们使用 Rudin-Shapiro 序列的平面部分和曲线，在限制 Kloosterman 过程的支持下显式构造了一条空间填充曲线。定性存在陈述之前被 Kowalski 认为是 J. Bober 的。得到的曲线是一个闭合的 $1/2$-H\"older 连续循环，其图像包含面积为 $1/128$ 的指定三角形。它的傅里叶系数纯粹是虚数，并且满足 $|\widehat f(h)|\leq(2\pi|h|)^{-1}$ for $h\ne 0$。我们还证明了以固定系数的闭合 $1/2$-H\"older 曲线为中心的小球的统一下界界，形式为 $\exp\{-C\varepsilon^{-2}\log^2(2/\varepsilon)\}$。然后，已知的函数收敛性给出了逼近构造环路的两参数 Kloosterman 路径的限制比例的定量下界。

items.title: A Non-Split Motohashi Formula for Toric Periods over Number Fields
items.excerpt: We establish a non-split Motohashi formula for toric Eisenstein periods over an arbitrary number field $F$. For a quadratic extension $E/F$, we compare toric Fourier inversion for a product of two Eisenstein series with the $\mathrm{GL}_2/F$-spectral expansion of its Rankin--Selberg kernel. The kernel regularizes the product in a cone of absolute convergence. Eisenstein corrections and contour residues give the geometric and residual terms in the meromorphically continued identity. Suitable test data give twisted first- and second-moment formulas for the completed $L$-functions of everywhere unramified toric characters. Over general $F$ these provide an adelic counterpart of the moment formulas of Duke--Friedlander--Iwaniec that does not use the geometry of Heegner points. In the CM case, we prove the absolute nonvanishing proportion $4.9\times10^{-4}$ for every totally real base field and all sufficiently large CM discriminants, with the threshold depending on the base field and no restriction on the number of ramified primes. We incorporate inverse Euler factors at small ramified primes into the mollifier. Local unit-group tests con
items.title_zh: 数域上复曲面周期的不可分割本桥公式
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在任意数域 $F$ 上建立了环面爱森斯坦周期的非分裂本桥公式。对于二次扩展$E/F$，我们将两个爱森斯坦级数的乘积的环面傅里叶反演与其Rankin-Selberg核的$\mathrm{GL}_2/F$谱扩展进行比较。核将乘积正则化为绝对收敛的锥体。爱森斯坦校正和轮廓残差给出了亚态连续恒等式中的几何项和残差项。合适的测试数据给出了所有无分支复曲面特征的完整 $L$ 函数的扭曲一阶矩和二阶矩公式。在一般的 $F$ 上，这些提供了 Duke-Friedlander-Iwaniec 的力矩公式的理想对应物，不使用 Heegner 点的几何形状。在 CM 情况下，我们证明了每个完全实基域和所有足够大的 CM 判别式的绝对非零比例 $4.9\times10^{-4}$，阈值取决于基域，并且对分支素数的数量没有限制。我们将小分支素数处的逆欧拉因子合并到缓和器中。本地单元组测试

items.title: Density Bounds in Hua's Theorem for Prime Squares
items.excerpt: We prove a density version of Hua's theorem in the five-variable case: if $\mathcal P$ is a subset of the primes with relative lower density greater than $0.82$, then every sufficiently large $n\equiv5\pmod{24}$ is a sum of five squares of primes from $\mathcal P$.
items.authors: Michael T. Lacey, Hamed Mousavi, Yaghoub Rahimi, Manasa N. Vempati
items.title_zh: 华氏素数平方定理中的密度界
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了华氏定理在五变量情况下的密度版本：如果 $\mathcal P$ 是相对较低密度大于 $0.82$ 的素数的子集，那么每个足够大的 $n\equiv5\pmod{24}$ 都是来自 $\mathcal P$ 的五个素数的平方和。

items.title: Galois Groups of Trinomials with Small Coefficients
items.excerpt: We calculate the Galois group of $f = x^n + ax^k + b \in \mathbb{Z}\left[ x \right]$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ for all $1 \leq \left| ab \right| \leq 3$, $n$ sufficiently large and $k$ coprime to $n$. In particular, we prove that the Galois group of $f$ is the maximal one that its factorization type allows. We do it by proving a new sufficient condition for the Galois group of a factor of a trinomial to be symmetric, which perhaps can be used to derive stronger results of this kind in the future.
items.title_zh: 小系数三项式伽罗瓦群
items.excerpt_zh: 我们针对所有 $1 \leq \left| 计算 $f = x^n + ax^k + b \in \mathbb{Z}\left[ x \right]$ 在 $\mathbb{Q}$ 上的伽罗瓦群ab \右| \leq 3$，$n$ 足够大并且$k$ 与$n$ 互质。特别是，我们证明 $f$ 的伽罗瓦群是其因式分解类型允许的最大群。我们通过证明三项式因子的伽罗瓦群对称的新充分条件来做到这一点，这也许可以用来在未来导出更强的此类结果。

items.title: Poisson-Dirichlet statistics for the log-modulus of the Riemann zeta function on expanding intervals near the critical line
items.excerpt: For $T > 0$ large, let $\tau$ be uniformly distributed on $[T,2T]$ and let $\sigma = \sigma(T)$ be a deterministic real part approaching $1/2$ from the right. For the Riemann zeta function $\zeta$, we study the Gibbs measure with density proportional to $|\zeta(\sigma + \mathrm{i}\tau + \mathrm{i} h)|^{\beta}$ on $I_{\theta} := [ - (\log{T})^{\theta},(\log{T})^{\theta}]$, for every $\theta > 0$ and $\beta > 0$. As $\beta$ increases, the Gibbs measure increasingly favors positions where $|\zeta|$ is large, providing a way to study the spatial organization of extreme values. Under explicit conditions on the rate at which $\sigma$ approaches the critical line, a phase transition is established at the critical inverse temperature $\beta_{c}(\theta) := 2\sqrt{1 + \theta}$. The limiting distribution of the correlation (or overlap) between the field values at two positions sampled from the Gibbs measure is concentrated at $0$ when $\beta \leq \beta_{c}(\theta)$, and assigns masses $\beta_{c}(\theta)/\beta$ and $1 - \beta_{c}(\theta)/\beta$ to $0$ and $1$, respectively, when $\beta > \beta_{c}(\theta)$. Joint convergence of the overlaps is al
items.title_zh: 黎曼 zeta 函数在临界线附近扩展区间上的对数模的泊松-狄利克雷统计
items.excerpt_zh: 对于 $T > 0$ 大，令 $\tau$ 均匀分布在 $[T,2T]$ 上，并令 $\sigma = \sigma(T)$ 为从右侧逼近 $1/2$ 的确定性实部。对于黎曼 zeta 函数 $\zeta$，我们研究 $|\zeta(\sigma + \mathrm{i}\tau + \mathrm{i} h)|^{\beta}$ 在 $I_{\theta} := [ - (\log{T})^{\theta},(\log{T})^{\theta}]$ 上的密度与 $|\zeta(\sigma + \mathrm{i}\tau + \mathrm{i} h)|^{\beta}$ 成正比的吉布斯测度，对于每个 $\theta > 0$且 $\beta > 0$。随着 $\beta$ 的增加，吉布斯测度越来越倾向于 $|\zeta|$ 较大的位置，从而提供了一种研究极值空间组织的方法。在 $\sigma$ 接近临界线的速率的明确条件下，在临界逆温度 $\beta_{c}(\theta) := 2\sqrt{1 + \theta}$ 处建立相变。当 $\beta \leq \beta_{c}(\theta)$ 时，吉布斯测度采样的两个位置处的场值之间的相关性（或重叠）的极限分布集中在 $0$，并且当 $\beta > 时，将质量 $\beta_{c}(\theta)/\beta$ 和 $1 - \beta_{c}(\theta)/\beta$ 分别分配给 $0$ 和 $1$ \beta_{c}(\theta)$。重叠的联合收敛是 al

items.title: Metric Poissonian Pair Correlation Property Part 2: The Case \(n\log n\)
items.excerpt: We prove that $(\alpha n\log n)_{n\ge1}$ has Poissonian pair correlation for almost every real $\alpha$, solving a Problem posed by Aistleitner, El-Baz and Munsch [Open Problem 3, Geom. Funct. Anal. 2021]. Our main contribution is a new four-point counting estimate with a fixed power saving over $N^{7/3}$ at tolerance $N^{-1}$, valid on the ranges left after a first-moment and Borel--Cantelli argument. Its proof reduces the counting condition to the required proximity of an implicitly defined real root to an integer; a Fej\'er kernel majorizes this condition, and multidimensional van der Corput $A$- and $B$-processes supply the saving. A localized Mellin argument then yields the second-moment estimate needed for the metric conclusion.
items.authors: Bo Tan, Zhen Zhang, Qing-Long Zhou
items.title_zh: 度量泊松对相关性第 2 部分：案例 \(n\log n\)
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明 $(\alpha n\log n)_{n\ge1}$ 对于几乎每个真实的 $\alpha$ 都具有泊松对相关性，解决了 Aistleitner、El-Baz 和 Munsch 提出的问题 [开放问题 3, Geom.功能。肛门。 2021]。我们的主要贡献是一种新的四点计数估计，在公差 $N^{-1}$ 下固定功耗超过 $N^{7/3}$，在第一时刻和 Borel--Cantelli 论证后留下的范围内有效。它的证明将计数条件简化为隐式定义的实数根与整数所需的接近度； Fej\'er 内核主要满足此条件，多维 van der Corput $A$- 和 $B$- 进程提供了节省。然后，局部梅林论证会产生度量结论所需的二阶矩估计。

items.title: Metric Poissonian Pair Correlation Property Part 1: The Case \(n+\log n\)
items.excerpt: We prove that $(\alpha(n+\log n))_{n\ge1}$ has Poissonian pair correlation for Lebesgue almost every real $\alpha$. This solves a Problem posed by Aistleitner, El-Baz and Munsch [Open Problem 2, Geom. Funct. Anal. 2021].
items.authors: Bo Tan, Zhen Zhang, Qing-Long Zhou
items.title_zh: 度量泊松对相关性第 1 部分：案例 \(n+\log n\)
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明 $(\alpha(n+\log n))_{n\ge1}$ 对于勒贝格几乎每个真实的 $\alpha$ 都具有泊松对相关性。这解决了 Aistleitner、El-Baz 和 Munsch 提出的问题 [开放问题 2，Geom。功能。肛门。 2021]。

items.title: Unconditional Bounds for Two, Three and Four Consecutive Moderate Gaps between Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function
items.excerpt: We prove unconditional positive-proportion results for consecutive moderate gaps between zeros of the Riemann zeta function. More precisely, for every fixed \(00\). The proof combines Lamzouri's Hilbert-space formulation of the Montgomery--Taylor second-moment method with local spectral estimates for simple critical-line zeros and a cluster-counting argument that accounts for multiple zeros and zeros off the critical line.
items.authors: C\'esar Ang\'on, Erick Ross, Ze Sen Tang, Boyang Zhao
items.title_zh: 黎曼 Zeta 函数零点之间两个、三个和四个连续中等间隙的无条件界
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了黎曼 zeta 函数零点之间连续适度间隙的无条件正比例结果。更准确地说，对于每个固定的 \(00\)。该证明将 Montgomery-Taylor 二阶矩方法的 Lamzouri 希尔伯特空间公式与简单临界线零点的局部谱估计以及考虑多个零点和临界线外零点的簇计数参数相结合。

items.title: The square achievement game on $n \times n$ boards
items.excerpt: Two players alternately claim cells of an $n \times n$ grid; the first to hold all four corners of an axis-parallel square wins, and a full board without one is a draw. The first player has a winning strategy if and only if $n \ge 5$, which answers a question of Erickson. For $n \ge 6$ one strategy serves every board: a rule with no lookup table whose moves after the second reply are all forcing, built around the plus, a stone with the four cells at a common distance from it along the axes, a shape proposed for this game by Sirgedas in 2010. The rule is checked on the boards of size $6$ to $17$, and a simulation theorem carries one checked run on the $23 \times 23$ board to every larger board. The proofs are formalized in Lean 4, and the theorem for the rule states that the tree of its own moves is winning.
items.title_zh: $n \times n$ 板上的方形成就游戏
items.excerpt_zh: 两名玩家交替占领 $n \times n$ 网格的单元格；第一个占据与轴平行的正方形的所有四个角的人获胜，而没有一个完整的棋盘则为平局。第一个玩家有获胜策略当且仅当 $n \ge 5$，这回答了埃里克森的问题。对于 $n \ge 6$ ，每个棋盘都有一个策略：没有查找表的规则，其在第二次答复后的移动都是强制的，围绕加号构建，一块石头，四个单元格沿轴与它的距离相同，这是 Sirgedas 在 2010 年为该游戏提出的形状。该规则在大小为 $6$ 到 $17$ 的棋盘上进行检查，并且模拟定理在 $23 \times 23$ 棋盘上进行一次检查运行到每个更大的棋盘。证明在精益 4 中得到了形式化，并且该规则的定理表明，其自身动作的树获胜。

items.title: Generating functions of hypermaps and m-constellations with two alternating boundaries
items.excerpt: We study the enumeration of planar hypermaps with several alternating boundaries. We first derive a peeling recursion with an arbitrary number of alternating boundaries and, in the two- boundary case, translate it into a functional equation for the corresponding generating function. Our main result is an explicit solution of this equation for m-constellations. In particular, we obtain a rational expression for the genus-zero two-point function, or cylinder generating function, with two alternating boundaries.
items.title_zh: 生成具有两个交替边界的超图和 m 星座的函数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究具有多个交替边界的平面超图的枚举。我们首先推导具有任意数量的交替边界的剥离递归，并且在双边界情况下，将其转换为相应生成函数的函数方程。我们的主要结果是 m 星座方程的显式解。特别是，我们获得了具有两个交替边界的亏格零两点函数或柱面生成函数的有理表达式。

items.title: Asymptotic dimension of graphs excluding an induced or fat minor
items.excerpt: Asymptotic dimension is a large-scale invariant of metric spaces that was introduced by Gromov (1993). A major open problem in coarse graph theory asks whether, for every fixed graph $H$, the class of graphs excluding $H$ as a fat minor has bounded asymptotic dimension. A weaker conjecture asserts the same conclusion for graphs excluding $H$ as an induced minor. We substantially expand the range of graphs $H$ for which these conjectures are known to hold. Specifically, we prove bounded asymptotic dimension for the following classes of graphs: graphs excluding a fixed planar graph as a fat minor; and graphs excluding a fixed string graph as an induced minor. All of our results also hold for the stronger notion of Assouad--Nagata dimension, a refinement of asymptotic dimension. These results have a number of applications, two of which we mention here. First they imply that an induced minor-closed class is $\chi$-bounded if and only if it does not contain some Burling graph. Second they imply that, in graph classes excluding a fixed planar graph as an induced minor, treewidth is polynomial in maximum degree.
items.authors: Robert Hickingbotham, Freddie Illingworth, Piotr Micek, Bartosz Walczak
items.title_zh: 排除诱导或脂肪小数的图的渐近维数
items.excerpt_zh: 渐近维数是由 Gromov (1993) 引入的度量空间的大规模不变量。粗略图论中的一个主要开放问题是，对于每个固定图 $H$，排除 $H$ 作为胖小数的图类是否具有有界渐近维数。较弱的猜想对于排除 $H$ 作为诱导未成年人的图表断言相同的结论。我们大大扩展了已知这些猜想成立的图表 $H$ 的范围。具体来说，我们证明以下几类图的有界渐近维数：排除固定平面图作为胖次要图的图；以及排除固定弦图作为诱导小调的图。我们所有的结果也适用于 Assouad 的更强概念——Nagata 维数，即渐近维数的细化。这些结果有许多应用，我们在这里提到其中两个。首先，它们暗示诱导小闭类当且仅当它不包含某些 Burling 图时才是 $\chi$ 有界的。其次，它们意味着，在排除固定平面图作为诱导次要图的图类中，树宽是最大次数的多项式。

items.title: Four colours are needed for closed-neighbourhood conflict-free colouring of all planar graphs
items.excerpt: A colouring of the vertices of a graph is conflict-free with respect to closed neighbourhoods if every closed neighbourhood contains a colour that appears on exactly one of its vertices. The colouring need not be proper. Every planar graph has such a colouring with four colours. Fabrici, Lu\v{z}ar, Rindo\v{s}ov\'a and Sot\'ak conjectured that three colours always suffice. We disprove this conjecture. We give a simple gadget construction that turns every planar graph of chromatic number four into a planar graph with no such colouring with three colours. This also shows that it is NP-complete to decide whether three colours suffice for a planar graph. We also give a planar graph on $25$ vertices that needs four colours. Further, we give critical planar graphs on $25$ vertices with $52$ and with $51$ edges, an infinite family of plane triangulations that need four colours, and an infinite family of critical examples.
items.title_zh: 所有平面图的闭邻域无冲突着色需要四种颜色
items.excerpt_zh: 如果每个闭邻域都包含恰好出现在其一个顶点上的颜色，则图的顶点着色对于闭邻域而言是无冲突的。颜色不必是正确的。每个平面图都有这样的四种颜色的着色。 Fabrici、Lu\v{z}ar、Rindo\v{s}ov\'a 和 Sot\'ak 推测三种颜色总是足够的。我们反驳这个猜想。我们给出了一个简单的小工具结构，将每个四色的平面图变成没有这种着色的三种颜色的平面图。这也表明，决定三种颜色是否足以满足平面图的问题是 NP 完全的。我们还给出了一个 25 美元顶点的平面图，需要四种颜色。此外，我们给出了 $25$ 顶点、$52$ 和 $51$ 边的关键平面图、需要四种颜色的平面三角剖分的无限系列，以及关键示例的无限系列。

items.title: The Schubert bialgebra
items.excerpt: We introduce a Schubert bialgebra $\mathcal{A}=\bigoplus_{n\geq 0}\mathbb{Z}[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$, in which polynomials in different numbers of variables multiply to zero and the coproduct splits the variables into two consecutive blocks, and study its graded dual $\mathcal{D}$, whose product is concatenation of weak compositions. The Schubert polynomials $\mathfrak{S}_u^n$ form a basis of $\mathcal{A}$; we give an explicit formula for the dual Schubert basis $\Xi_u^n$ of $\mathcal{D}$ via a transition formula to an elementary symmetric basis, and show that the Schubert structure constants $c_{u,v}^w$ are the coefficients of the coproduct of $\mathcal{D}$ in the dual Schubert basis. The product of $\mathcal{D}$ is then lifted to an associative product $\sqcup$ on the free abelian group $\mathcal{BRC}$ of bounded RC graphs, built from a transition map $\mathcal{Z}$ on RC graphs that realizes the Lascoux-Sch\"utzenberger transition formula and generalizes Little's bumping algorithm. Quotienting $\mathcal{BRC}$ by ideals coming from Demazure crystal equivalence, Nadeau-Tewari forest equivalence, and quasi-Yamanouchi equivalence yields manife
items.title_zh: 舒伯特双代数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们引入了舒伯特双代数 $\mathcal{A}=\bigoplus_{n\geq 0}\mathbb{Z}[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$，其中不同数量变量的多项式乘以零，余积将变量分成两个连续的块，并研究其分级对偶 $\mathcal{D}$，其乘积是弱组合的串联。舒伯特多项式 $\mathfrak{S}_u^n$ 构成 $\mathcal{A}$ 的基础；我们通过一个初等对称基的过渡公式给出了$\mathcal{D}$的对偶舒伯特基$\Xi_u^n$的显式公式，并证明了舒伯特结构常数$c_{u,v}^w$是对偶舒伯特基中$\mathcal{D}$的余积的系数。然后，$\mathcal{D}$ 的乘积被提升为有界 RC 图的自由阿贝尔群 $\mathcal{BRC}$ 上的关联乘积 $\sqcup$，该关联乘积是根据 RC 图上的转换映射 $\mathcal{Z}$ 构建的，实现了 Lascoux-Sch\"utzenberger 转换公式并推广了 Little 的碰撞算法。通过理想对 $\mathcal{BRC}$ 进行求商来自 Demazure 晶体等价、Nadeau-Tewari 森林等价和准 Yamanouchi 等价产生 manife

items.title: Complete regular dessins: the nonmetacyclic case
items.excerpt: We classify regular dessins on $K_{2^e,2^f}$ with nonmetacyclic colour-preserving automorphism group, retaining the two specified vertex rotations. We give nonredundant presentations and exact counts in both the abelian and nonabelian Frattini cases. For orientation- and colour-preserving isomorphisms, the number is $2^{2e-2}+16$ when $e=f\ge4$ and $3\cdot2^{2f-3}+16$ when $e>f\ge4$, with explicit counts for all smaller exponents. The construction uses a parity criterion in the abelian case and a uniquely determined odd quadratic root with two lifts in the nonabelian case. A dessin in the classification is reflexible exactly when its Frattini subgroup is abelian. All symmetric classes are circular. We determine every circular subfamily, including its face orders and genera; the circular count is $2^e+8$ on the diagonal and $2^{f-2}(2^{f-1}+1)+8$ off the diagonal for $e\ge f\ge4$.
items.title_zh: 完全正则设计：非元循环情况
items.excerpt_zh: 我们使用非元循环保色自同构群对 $K_{2^e,2^f}$ 上的常规设计进行分类，保留两个指定的顶点旋转。我们在阿贝尔和非阿贝尔弗拉蒂尼情况下都给出了非冗余的介绍和精确计数。对于保持方向和颜色的同构，当 $e=f\ge4$ 时，该数字为 $2^{2e-2}+16$；当 $e>f\ge4$ 时，该数字为 $3\cdot2^{2f-3}+16$，并对所有较小的指数进行显式计数。该构造在阿贝尔情况下使用奇偶校验准则，在非阿贝尔情况下使用唯一确定的具有两次提升的奇二次根。当分类中的德斯因的弗拉蒂尼子群是阿贝尔群时，它就是自反的。所有对称类都是圆形的。我们确定每个圆形亚科，包括其面目和属；对于 $e\ge f\ge4$，对角线上的循环计数为 $2^e+8$，对角线外的循环计数为 $2^{f-2}(2^{f-1}+1)+8$。

items.title: Spectral asymmetry and odd cycles in integral graphs
items.excerpt: We prove that the triangle $C_3$ is the only integral unicyclic graph with an odd cycle. The main tool is a spectral inequality that does not require integrality: if $G$ is a connected non-bipartite graph and $G-e$ is bipartite for some edge $e$, then the eigenvalues $\lambda_1\ge\cdots\ge\lambda_n$ of $G$ satisfy $\sum_{i}(\lambda_i+\lambda_{n+1-i})^+\le 2$ and $0<\lambda_1+\lambda_n\le 1$. It follows from comparing $A(G)$ with the signed adjacency matrix obtained by reversing the sign of $e$, which is similar to $-A(G)$, through a common rank-one perturbation and Weyl's monotonicity theorem. For integral graphs in this class, an arithmetic lemma then gives $\lambda_n=1-\lambda_1$ and at least $\lambda_1-1\ge1$ triangles, which yields the classification. We also prove that an integral graph of odd girth $g$ has at least $(g-1)!/2$ cycles of length $g$, with equality for the Petersen graph when $g=5$, and we derive consequences for quantum periodicity a
items.authors: Rodrigo O. Braga, Jean Carlo Moraes, Matheus C. Santos
items.title_zh: 积分图中的谱不对称性和奇循环
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明三角形$C_3$是唯一具有奇数环的积分单环图。主要工具是不需要完整性的谱不等式：如果$G$是连通的非二分图，并且$G-e$对于某些边$e$是二分图，则$G$的特征值$\lambda_1\ge\cdots\ge\lambda_n$满足$\sum_{i}(\lambda_i+\lambda_{n+1-i})^+\le 2$并且$0<\lambda_1+\lambda_n\le 1$。它是通过将 $A(G)$ 与通过共同的一阶扰动和 Weyl 单调性定理将 $e$ 的符号反转而获得的带符号邻接矩阵进行比较得出的，该邻接矩阵类似于 $-A(G)$。对于此类中的积分图，算术引理给出 $\lambda_n=1-\lambda_1$ 和至少 $\lambda_1-1\ge1$ 三角形，从而产生分类。我们还证明了奇数周长 $g$ 的积分图至少有 $(g-1)!/2$ 长度为 $g$ 的周期，当 $g=5$ 时彼得森图相等，并且我们得出了量子周期性 a 的结果

items.title: On the existence of mixed orthogonal arrays of strength two with six factors
items.excerpt: Orthogonal arrays are foundational objects in combinatorial design theory and experimental design theory, with broad applications in computer science, coding theory, and cryptography. In this paper, we investigate the existence for mixed orthogonal arrays of strength two with six factors, and propose several new constructions based on incomplete orthogonal Latin squares, incomplete transversal designs, and $\Sigma$-resolvable transversal designs. As a result, we show that the necessary conditions for the existence of such mixed orthogonal arrays are also sufficient, except for a small number of known exceptions and nine unsettled cases.
items.authors: Xiuling Shan, Guangzhou Chen, Xiangrong Sun
items.title_zh: 关于强度二六因子混合正交阵的存在性
items.excerpt_zh: 正交阵列是组合设计理论和实验设计理论的基础对象，在计算机科学、编码理论和密码学中具有广泛的应用。在本文中，我们研究了具有六个因子的强度为 2 的混合正交阵列的存在性，并提出了几种基于不完全正交拉丁方、不完全横向设计和 $\Sigma$ 可解析横向设计的新构造。结果，我们表明，除了少数已知的例外和九个未解决的情况外，这种混合正交数组存在的必要条件也是充分的。

items.title: Computing S(X) for Ruled Surfaces Defined by Stable Bundles on Curves of Genus 2
items.excerpt: This paper discusses the algebra of symmetric tensors for ruled surfaces defined by rank 2 stable vector bundles on curves of genus 2. The algebra is computed for special bundles $E$ when $S^2 E$ is destabilized by a line bundle and when $S^3 E$ is destabilized by a bundle of rank 2. A strategy for computation is discussed in regards to the other special bundles $E$. This paper also discusses the generalization of these strategies to higher genus and gives a computation when $E$ is not stable and may be written as a direct sum of line bundles.
items.title_zh: 计算由属 2 曲线上的稳定丛定义的直纹曲面的 S(X)
items.excerpt_zh: 本文讨论了亏格 2 曲线上的 2 阶稳定向量丛定义的直纹面对称张量的代数。当 $S^2 E$ 被线丛失稳时和当 $S^3 E$ 被 2 阶向量丛失稳时，计算特殊丛 $E$ 的代数。讨论了其他特殊丛 $E$ 的计算策略。本文还讨论了这些策略对更高属的推广，并给出了当 $E$ 不稳定并且可以写成线丛的直和时的计算。

items.title: Generic vanishing for Dolbeault cohomology of mixed Hodge modules on abelian varieties
items.excerpt: We study generic vanishing for the Dolbeault cohomology of mixed Hodge modules, where the differentials in the Dolbeault complex are modified by a one-form. We prove that, on the Dolbeault moduli space of Higgs line bundles, the cohomology support loci of mixed Hodge modules agree with the images of the cohomology support loci of their underlying $\mathscr{D}$-modules on the de Rham moduli space under the map induced by the nonabelian Hodge correspondence. We further apply this result to study Fourier-Mukai transforms of mixed Hodge modules on abelian varieties. We show that the extended Fourier-Mukai transform for bounded complexes of mixed Hodge modules has cohomology sheaves that are flat over the twistor line of $\lambda$-connections. This also gives an extension of Fourier transform of mixed Hodge modules to a compactification of the de Rham moduli space.
items.title_zh: 阿贝尔簇上混合 Hodge 模的 Dolbeault 上同调的一般消失
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究混合 Hodge 模的 Dolbeault 上同调的泛型消失，其中 Dolbeault 复形中的微分由一种形式修改。我们证明，在希格斯线丛的 Dolbeault 模空间上，混合 Hodge 模的上同调支持位点与其底层 $\mathscr{D}$-模的上同调支持位点在由非阿贝尔 Hodge 对应关系导出的映射下的 de Rham 模空间上的图像一致。我们进一步应用这一结果来研究阿贝尔簇上混合 Hodge 模的 Fourier-Mukai 变换。我们证明了混合 Hodge 模有界复形的扩展 Fourier-Mukai 变换具有在 $\lambda$ 连接的扭量线上平坦的上同调滑轮。这也给出了混合霍奇模的傅里叶变换对德拉姆模空间的压缩的扩展。

items.title: Vector bundles on singular surfaces and threefolds
items.excerpt: We fully classify vector bundles of critical rank on normal affine surfaces and threefolds over algebraically closed fields via their Chern classes. We also prove existence of rank $2$ bundles on threefolds with prescribed first and second motivic Chern classes. The main input is the motivic filtration on algebraic $K$-theory: its third piece is generated by smooth closed points and is identified with motivic cohomology by the third Chern class.
items.title_zh: 奇异曲面和三重曲面上的向量丛
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过 Chern 类对正常仿射曲面上的临界秩向量束和代数闭域上的三重向量束进行完全分类。我们还证明了具有规定的第一和第二动机 Chern 类的三重等级 $2$ 捆绑的存在。主要输入是代数 $K$ 理论的动机过滤：其第三部分由平滑闭点生成，并由第三 Chern 类用动机上同调来识别。

items.title: Hypercube Richardson varieties from magic words
items.excerpt: Inspired by the recent preprint of Ellenberg, Libedinsky, Plaza, Simental, and Williamson, we study the geometry of Richardson varieties whose associated Bruhat intervals are boolean posets. We define magic words for a Bruhat interval and prove that for intervals with magic words the associated Richardson variety is a tower of $\mathbb{P}^1$-s. We also prove that the Bruhat intervals consisting of the dyadically well-distributed permutations all have magic words. This gives a new proof that they form a boolean poset.
items.title_zh: 超立方理查森变体来自魔法词
items.excerpt_zh: 受到 Ellenberg、Libedinsky、Plaza、Simental 和 Williamson 最近预印本的启发，我们研究了理查森簇的几何形状，其相关的 Bruhat 区间是布尔偏序集。我们为 Bruhat 区间定义魔词，并证明对于带有魔词的区间，相关的 Richardson 簇是 $\mathbb{P}^1$-s 的塔。我们还证明了由二元良好分布排列组成的 Bruhat 区间都具有魔词。这给出了它们形成布尔偏序集的新证据。

items.title: $a$-numbers of covers in characteristic two: semigroups and Riemann-Roch spaces
items.excerpt: We compute the $a$-numbers of the Garcia-G\"uneri-Stichtenoth curves, the Beelen-Montanucci curves, and the Skabelund covers of Suzuki curves in characteristic two. The proofs use the identity $a(X)=\ell(\tfrac12\operatorname{div}(dt))$ and reduce the calculations to Riemann-Roch spaces on the base curves. We obtain transfer formulas for odd-degree radical covers, with one or several points at infinity, and evaluate them using Weierstrass semigroups and plane sections of the Hermitian curve. For the first two families we also give cyclic models over the projective line and relate the formulas to Elkin's rank formula. We then treat two classes of Artin-Schreier fibre products. A supersingular genus-six family has a-number $3$ at the zero parameter and $2$ elsewhere, although the genera and $a$-numbers of its quadratic quotients remain fixed. We determine its Ekedahl--Oort types as $(0,0,0,1,2,3)$ and $(0,1,1,2,3,4)$,
items.authors: Gilberto B. Almeida Filho, Saeed Tafazolian, St\'efani C. Vieira
items.title_zh: $a$-特征二中的覆盖数：半群和黎曼-罗赫空间
items.excerpt_zh: 我们计算特征二中 Garcia-G\"uneri-Stichtenoth 曲线、Beelen-Montanucci 曲线和 Suzuki 曲线的 Skabelund 覆盖的 $a$ 数。证明使用恒等式 $a(X)=\ell(\tfrac12\operatorname{div}(dt))$ 并将计算减少到基本曲线上的 Riemann-Roch 空间。我们获得奇数次根式覆盖的传递公式，其中 1 或无穷远的几个点，并使用 Weierstrass 半群和 Hermitian 曲线的平面截面来评估它们，我们还给出了投影线上的循环模型，并将公式与 Elkin 的秩公式联系起来，然后我们处理两类 Artin-Schreier 纤维乘积，在零参数处有一个数 $3$ ，在其他地方有 $2$ ，尽管其二次项的属数和 $a$ 数。我们确定其 Ekedahl-Oort 类型为 $(0,0,0,1,2,3)$ 和 $(0,1,1,2,3,4)$，

items.title: $R$-trivial Galois cohomology classes and cohomological $p$-dimension
items.excerpt: Given a prime $p$, a field $F$ of characteristic different from $p$ and a finite $p$-primary Galois module $V$, a Galois cohomology class in $H^n(F,V)$ is called $R$-trivial if it can be connected to $0$ by a class defined over an open subscheme of the projective line. All classes of $H^n(F,V)$ are $R$-trivial if $F$ has cohomological $p$-dimension at most $n$, by the Bloch-Kato conjecture. We show that this bound is sharp: working over fields of iterated Laurent series, we produce, for every $n\geq 1$, a field $F$ of cohomological $p$-dimension $n+1$ and a Galois module $V$ such that $H^n(F,V)$ contains classes which are not $R$-trivial. The module $V$ is a quotient of the permutation module on the affine hyperplanes of an elementary abelian $p$-group, arising as a quotient of the absolute Galois group of $F$. We also describe $R$-trivial classes as sums of corestrictions of cup products involving a Kummer class.
items.title_zh: $R$-平凡伽罗瓦上同调类和上同调 $p$-维数
items.excerpt_zh: 给定素数 $p$、特征不同于 $p$ 的域 $F$ 和有限 $p$-主伽罗瓦模 $V$，$H^n(F,V)$ 中的伽罗瓦上同调类被称为 $R$-平凡，如果它可以通过在射影线的开子方案上定义的类连接到 $0$。根据布洛赫-加藤猜想，如果 $F$ 最多具有 $n$ 上同调 $p$ 维数，则 $H^n(F,V)$ 的所有类都是 $R$-平凡的。我们证明这个界限是尖锐的：在迭代洛朗级数的域上工作，对于每个 $n\geq 1$，我们生成一个上同调 $p$-维度 $n+1$ 的域 $F$ 和一个伽罗瓦模块 $V$，使得 $H^n(F,V)$ 包含不是 $R$-平凡的类。模 $V$ 是基本交换 $p$ 群的仿射超平面上的置换模的商，作为 $F$ 的绝对伽罗瓦群的商而出现。我们还将 $R$-平凡类描述为涉及 Kummer 类的杯积的限制总和。

items.title: Low-weight compactly supported cohomology of $\mathcal M_{g,n}^{ct}$ and the extended Torelli morphism
items.excerpt: We study the weight zero and weight two graded pieces of the compactly supported cohomology of the moduli space $\mathcal M_{g,n}^{ct}$ of stable $n$-pointed curves of genus $g$ of compact type and show that they are computed by bridgeless graph complexes. In weight two, we construct a natural embedding of shifted weight zero cohomology from lower genus. For unmarked curves, we construct canonical classes represented by pinched odd wheel graphs and prove that distinct wheel monomials give linearly independent classes in the dual of $W_0H_c^{2g}(\mathcal M_g^{ct};\mathbb Q)$. By relating the bridgeless graph complex to the $K$-theory of graphs and the Quillen spectral sequence, we show that these classes remain linearly independent after pushforward along the extended Torelli morphism $\mathcal M_g^{ct}\to\mathcal A_g$. Finally, we prove that the realizations of the motivic Lie algebra arising from $\mathcal M_g$ and $\mathcal A_g$ have the same image in the weight zero compactly supported cohomology of $\mathcal M_g^{ct}$.
items.title_zh: $\mathcal M_{g,n}^{ct}$ 的低权紧支持上同调和扩展 Torelli 态射
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了紧型类型 $g$ 的稳定 $n$ 点曲线的模空间 $\mathcal M_{g,n}^{ct}$ 的紧支撑上同调的权重零和权重二阶部分，并表明它们是通过无桥图复形计算的。在权重二中，我们从较低的属构建了移位权重零上同调的自然嵌入。对于未标记的曲线，我们构造由收缩奇数轮图表示的规范类，并证明不同的轮单项式在 $W_0H_c^{2g}(\mathcal M_g^{ct};\mathbb Q)$ 的对偶中给出线性独立的类。通过将无桥图复形与图的 $K$ 理论和 Quillen 谱序列联系起来，我们表明这些类在沿着扩展 Torelli 态射 $\mathcal M_g^{ct}\to\mathcal A_g$ 推进后保持线性独立。最后，我们证明$\mathcal M_g$和$\mathcal A_g$产生的动机李代数的实现在$\mathcal M_g^{ct}$的权零紧支持上同调中具有相同的图像。

items.title: The geometric exceptional set for Fano threefolds
items.excerpt: We study the geometric exceptional set in Manin's conjecture for smooth Fano threefolds. We prove that every adjoint rigid surface with $a$-invariant one on a non-product smooth Fano threefold is normal. This yields a description of the geometric exceptional set in terms of the higher-$a$ locus, anticanonical conics, and del Pezzo fibrations. Zariski density arise only from the latter two contributions. For del Pezzo fibrations, we construct a finite collection of parameter covers which controlling the associated breaking maps. We classify their low-genus components for general smooth Fano threefolds yielding examples with potentially Zariski dense geometric exceptional sets in $22$ of the $105$ deformation families. Extending Batyrev-Tschinkel's example, we construct Fano fourfolds with quartic del Pezzo fibrations and an explicit Fano threefold with two degree-six del Pezzo fibrations, all with Zariski dense geometric exceptional sets. For this threefold, the original form of Manin's conjecture fails on every non-empty open subset for every anticanonical height.
items.title_zh: 法诺三重的几何特殊套装
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究马宁平滑法诺三重猜想中的几何例外集。我们证明，非产品光滑 Fano 三重上的每个伴随刚性表面与 $a$ 不变的表面都是正常的。这产生了用较高 $a$ 轨迹、反正则圆锥曲线和 del Pezzo 纤维来描述几何例外集。 Zariski 密度仅由后两个贡献产生。对于 del Pezzo 纤维，我们构建了参数覆盖的有限集合，用于控制相关的断裂图。我们将它们的低属组件分类为一般平滑的 Fano 三倍，产生具有潜在 Zariski 密集几何例外集的示例，其中 $22$ 为 $105$ 变形族。扩展 Batyrev-Tschinkel 的例子，我们用四次 del Pezzo 纤维构造了 Fano 四重，并用二阶六度 del Pezzo 纤维构造了显式 Fano 三重，所有这些都具有 Zariski 稠密几何例外集。对于这三重，马宁猜想的原始形式在每个反规范高度的每个非空开子集上都失败了。

items.title: Quadratic mixing for the Lee--Sidford Dikin walk
items.excerpt: Let $K=\{x\in\R^d:Ax\ge b\}$ be a bounded full-dimensional polytope with $m$ inequalities. For targets on $K$ with density proportional to $\exp(-\vartheta^\transpose x)$, we prove a $\widetilde O(d^2)$ bound, measured in Markov chain iterations, for the chi-square mixing of the $1/2$-lazy Metropolis Dikin walk based on a polylogarithmically rescaled Lee--Sidford metric. The estimate holds for every initial law with finite chi-square divergence. The proof controls the reverse Gaussian proposal through a quantitative average self-concordance estimate at the required $O(1/d)$ scale. We establish this estimate from uniform analytic derivative bounds for the Lewis-weight subspace and an all-order projection-weighted contraction inequality for Gaussian chaoses. For order $j$, the latter bounds each base-point polynomial at scale $d^{j/2}$, up to $j$-dependent and logarithmic factors. Truncating at logarithmic order then absorbs the remaining pathwise loss. This resolves, in the affirmative, the open problem of whether the Gaussian Lee--Sidford Dikin walk mixes in $\widetilde O(d^2)$ iterations: the previously stated quadratic bounds \cite[
items.title_zh: Lee--Sidford Dikin 步道的二次混合
items.excerpt_zh: 设 $K=\{x\in\R^d:Ax\ge b\}$ 为有 $m$ 个不等式的有界全维多胞形。对于 $K$ 上密度与 $\exp(-\vartheta^\transpose x)$ 成比例的目标，我们证明了 $\widetilde O(d^2)$ 界限，以马尔可夫链迭代测量，用于基于多对数重新缩放的 Lee-Sidford 度量的 $1/2$-懒惰 Metropolis Dikin 行走的卡方混合。该估计对于每个具有有限卡方散度的初始定律都成立。该证明通过所需的 $O(1/d)$ 规模的定量平均自一致性估计来控制反向高斯提议。我们根据刘易斯权重子空间的均匀解析导数界和高斯混沌的全阶投影加权收缩不等式建立了该估计。对于 $j$ 阶，后者将每个基点多项式限制在 $d^{j/2}$ 范围内，最多为 $j$ 相关因子和对数因子。然后以对数阶截断吸收剩余的路径损失。肯定的是，这解决了高斯李-西德福德迪金行走是否混合在 $\widetilde O(d^2)$ 迭代中的开放问题：前面提到的二次边界 \cite[

items.title: Strict monotonicity of weighted inhomogeneous percolation thresholds under covering maps
items.excerpt: We study Bernoulli bond percolation under weak covering maps for a class of weighted inhomogeneous product measures such that each edge $e$ carries a positive weight $w(e)$ and is open at intensity $\lambda\geq 0$ with probability $1-\exp(-\lambda w(e))$. We prove a strict monotonicity of the weighted critical intensities $\lambda_c$ in the covering compatibility setting under bounded degree, uniform ellipticity, tame fibre and disjoint tree-lifting. While for the weighted uniform connection thresholds $\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$, we establish their strict monotonicity for non-injective weak covering maps under bounded degree, covering compatibility, uniform ellipticity, bounded-fibre and disjoint tree-lifting. Moreover, we verify a general-profile theorem on strict monotonicities of the two thresholds $\lambda_c$ and $\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$ respectively under explicit compact-interval finite-energy, derivative bounds and aforementioned geometric conditions.
items.authors: Jing Liu, Kainan Xiang, Lang Zou
items.title_zh: 覆盖图下加权非均匀渗流阈值的严格单调性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究一类加权非齐次乘积测度的弱覆盖图下的伯努利债券渗流，使得每条边 $e$ 都带有正权重 $w(e)$，并且在强度 $\lambda\geq 0$ 处以概率 $1-\exp(-\lambda w(e))$ 开放。我们证明了在有界度、均匀椭圆率、驯服纤维和不相交树提升下覆盖兼容性设置中加权临界强度 $\lambda_c$ 的严格单调性。而对于加权统一连接阈值$\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$，我们在有界度下为非内射弱覆盖图建立了严格的单调性，包括覆盖兼容性、均匀椭圆率、有界纤维和不相交树提升。此外，我们分别在显式紧区间有限能量、导数界限和上述几何条件下验证了两个阈值 $\lambda_c$ 和 $\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$ 严格单调性的一般轮廓定理。

items.title: The transition between order to disorder in the Sepp\"al\"ainen-Johansson model
items.excerpt: We study the Sepp\"al\"ainen-Johansson model of first-passage percolation along a region of the plane where it moves from an ordered to a disordered phase, represented by a 2nd order discontinuity in its limit shape function. The fluctuations in this transition region are of order one, and we determine that certain limiting statistics are described by Fredholm determinants and are closely related to the largest eigenvalue of the GUE.
items.title_zh: Sepp\"al\"ainen-Johansson 模型中有序到无序的转变
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了沿着平面区域的第一通道渗透的 Sepp\"al\"ainen-Johansson 模型，在该区域中它从有序相移动到无序相，由其极限形状函数中的二阶不连续性表示。该过渡区域的波动是一阶的，我们确定某些限制统计量由 Fredholm 行列式描述，并且与 GUE 的最大特征值密切相关。

items.title: Volterra-Skorokhod Reflection and Fluid Limits of Loss Queues
items.excerpt: In the $G_t/G/n/n$ loss queue, a customer blocked at time $u$ remains missing from the system for as long as it would have been served. A fraction $K(t-u)$ of the blocking at $u$ therefore still affects the occupancy at time $t$, where $K=1-G$ is the service survival function. We show that, for every arrival process satisfying a functional strong law of large numbers, the fluid limit of this queue is a reflection with kernel $K$ of the fluid limit of the associated infinite-server queue. The reflection is defined by a one-sided reflection problem on $(-\infty,1]$ in which the regulator is convolved with a memory kernel. Given a c\`adl\`ag input $\rho$ and a kernel $K$ with $K(0)=1$, we seek a pair $(\hat\rho,\eta)$ such that $\hat\rho=\rho-\int_0^\cdot K(\cdot-u)\,d\eta(u)$ takes values in $(-\infty,1]$, $\eta$ is nondecreasing, and $\eta$ increases only when $\hat\rho=1$. We refer to this problem as the Volterra-Skorokhod problem. We show existence and uniqueness of the solution and that the solution map is Lipschitz continuous in the uniform norm and nonanticipating. It therefore applies to stochastic inputs path by path. Unlike the
items.title_zh: Volterra-Skorokhod 反射和丢失队列的流动极限
items.excerpt_zh: 在 $G_t/G/n/n$ 丢失队列中，在 $u$ 时间被阻止的客户在系统中一直缺失，只要该客户已得到服务。因此，$u$ 处阻塞的一小部分 $K(t-u)$ 仍然影响时间 $t$ 的占用率，其中 $K=1-G$ 是服务生存函数。我们证明，对于满足函数强大数定律的每个到达进程，该队列的流动限制是内核 $K$ 相关无限服务器队列的流动限制的反映。反射是由 $(-\infty,1]$ 上的单侧反射问题定义的，其中调节器与内存内核进行卷积。给定 c\`adl\`ag 输入 $\rho$ 和内核 $K$ 且 $K(0)=1$，我们寻找一对 $(\hat\rho,\eta)$，使得 $\hat\rho=\rho-\int_0^\cdot K(\cdot-u)\,d\eta(u)$ 取值在 $(-\infty,1]$ 中，$\eta$ 是非递减的，并且 $\eta$ 仅当 $\hat\rho=1$ 时增加。我们将此问题称为 Volterra-Skorokhod 问题。我们证明解的存在性和唯一性，并且解图在统一范数和非预期中是 Lipschitz 连续的。因此它适用于随机输入路径：与路径不同。

items.title: Singular vectors of sparse random rectangular matrices: Transition between delocalized and semilocalized phases
items.excerpt: Consider the bipartite Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi graph $\mathbb{G}(n,m,d/\sqrt{mn})$ at the critical sparsity $d = b\log(N)$ for some $b > 0$ with $N = n + m$, and constant aspect ratio $\gamma = n/m \geq 1$. We show that the spectrum of its centered and rescaled bi-adjacency matrix, whose limiting law is the Mar\v{c}enko--Pastur (MP) distribution, is split into two phases: in the bulk, singular vectors are completely delocalized, while near the edges, singular vectors are semilocalized, with their mass concentrating on small disjoint balls, centered at vertices with extreme degrees. As $b$ decreases, we identify sharp thresholds for the emergence of outlier singular values. For explicit $b_{\rm R}^{\star}$ and $b_{\rm L}^{\star}$ as functions of $\gamma$, we prove that when $b > b_{\rm R}^{\star}$, there is no outlier outside the bulk; when $b_{\rm L}^{\star}< b < b_{\rm R}^{\star}$, only right outliers emerge; and when $b < b_{\rm L}^{\star}$, outliers are present on both sides, all with high probability. This removes an extra technical condition from our previous work arxiv:2508.01456, providing a complete characterization of the paramete
items.title_zh: 稀疏随机矩形矩阵的奇异向量：离域相位和半局域相位之间的过渡
items.excerpt_zh: 考虑二分 Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi 图 $\mathbb{G}(n,m,d/\sqrt{mn})$，对于某些 $b > 0$，$N = n + m$，且纵横比 $\gamma = n/m \geq 1$，在临界稀疏度 $d = b\log(N)$ 处。我们证明了其中心和重新缩放的双邻接矩阵的谱，其极限法则是 Mar\v{c}enko--Pastur (MP) 分布，分为两个阶段：在整体中，奇异向量完全离域化，而在边缘附近，奇异向量是半局域化的，它们的质量集中在不相交的小球上，以极度数的顶点为中心。随着 $b$ 的减少，我们确定了异常奇异值出现的尖锐阈值。对于显式的 $b_{\rm R}^{\star}$ 和 $b_{\rm L}^{\star}$ 作为 $\gamma$ 的函数，我们证明当 $b > b_{\rm R}^{\star}$ 时，在块体之外不存在异常值；当 $b_{\rm L}^{\star}< b < b_{\rm R}^{\star}$ 时，仅出现正确的异常值；当$b < b_{\rm L}^{\star}$时，异常值出现在两侧，并且概率很高。这消除了我们之前的工作 arxiv:2508.01456 中的额外技术条件，提供了参数的完整表征

items.title: Normal approximation for total magnetization in subcritical long-range Ising models
items.excerpt: We establish Berry--Esseen bounds and 1-Wassershtein bounds for the total spin of strictly subcritical zero-field Ising models with summable interactions. Let $J:\mathbb Z^d\to[0,\infty)$ be symmetric, satisfy $J(0)=0$, and $\|J\|_1:=\sum_{x\in\mathbb Z^d}J(x)<\infty$. For a nonempty finite set $\Lambda\subset\mathbb Z^d$, consider zero-field Gibbs measure with free boundary conditions, in which a spin configuration $\sigma\in\{-1,+1\}^{\Lambda}$ has probability proportional to \[ \exp\!\left\{ \beta\sum_{x,y\in\Lambda} J(x-y)\sigma_x\sigma_y \right\}. \] Let $S_\Lambda:=\sum_{x\in\Lambda}\sigma_x$ be the total spin and $\beta_{\mathrm c}$ denote the critical inverse temperature. For every fixed $0\leq\beta<\beta_{\mathrm c}$, we prove that \[ d_{\mathrm K}\!\left( \frac{S_\Lambda}{\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(S_\Lambda)}},G \right) \leq C_{\beta,J}|\Lambda|^{-1/2}, \] where $d_{\mathrm K}$ is the Kolmogorov distance, $G\sim \mathcal{N}(0,1)$, and $C_{\beta,J}$ depends only on $\beta$ and $J$. items.authors: Song-Hao Liu, Qi-Man Shao, Yang Xie, Jing-Yu Xu
items.title_zh: 亚临界长程 Ising 模型中总磁化强度的正态近似
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为具有可求和相互作用的严格亚临界零场 Ising 模型的总自旋建立了 Berry--Esseen 界和 1-Wassershtein 界。设$J:\mathbb Z^d\to[0,\infty)$是对称的，满足$J(0)=0$，且$\|J\|_1:=\sum_{x\in\mathbb Z^d}J(x)<\infty$。对于非空有限集 $\Lambda\subset\mathbb Z^d$，考虑具有自由边界条件的零场吉布斯测度，其中自旋构型 $\sigma\in\{-1,+1\}^{\Lambda}$ 的概率与 \[ \exp\!\left\{ \beta\sum_{x,y\in\Lambda} J(x-y)\sigma_x\sigma_y \right\} 成正比。 \] 设 $S_\Lambda:=\sum_{x\in\Lambda}\sigma_x$ 为总自旋，$\beta_{\mathrm c}$ 表示临界逆温度。对于每个固定的 $0\leq\beta<\beta_{\mathrm c}$，我们证明 \[ d_{\mathrm K}\!\left( \frac{S_\Lambda}{\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(S_\Lambda)}},G \right) \leq C_{\beta,J}|\Lambda|^{-1/2}, \] 其中 $d_{\mathrm K}$ 是柯尔莫哥洛夫距离、$G\sim \mathcal{N}(0,1)$ 和 $C_{\beta,J}$ 仅取决于 $\beta$ 和 $J$。对于 $(\mathbb Z/L\mathbb Z)^d$ 上的完全周期模型，相应的比率为 $L^{-d/2}$，统一为 $L$。对于经典的最近邻

items.title: On Niu's Conjecture for Two-Station Tandem Queues
items.excerpt: In this paper, we prove a long standing conjecture in queueing theory made by Niu (1980): in a two-station tandem queueing system with constant service time (c) at station 1, the stationary average waiting time at station 2 is nonincreasing in c. Two very different proofs are provided: one for the general case and one for a special case in which the arrival process is Poisson and the service time at station 2 is exponential.
items.authors: Hao Cao, Jian-Qiang Hu, Qixin Wang
items.title_zh: 论牛氏两站串联队列猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们证明了Niu（1980）在排队论中的一个长期猜想：在一个两站串联排队系统中，在站1的服务时间（c）恒定的情况下，站2的平稳平均等待时间在c中不增加。提供了两种截然不同的证明：一种用于一般情况，另一种用于特殊情况，其中到达过程为泊松分布，且站 2 的服务时间为指数。

items.title: Sharp asymptotics for the Lov\'asz number of random circulant graphs
items.excerpt: We study the LOV\'ASZ number of dense random circulant graphs generated by independent Bernoulli bits indexed by cyclic distances. Although only $O(n)$ independent random inputs determine $O(n^2)$ globally dependent edge indicators, we prove sharp expectation asymptotics along all odd orders, including composite orders, with leading constant one. This resolves a conjecture posed for random circulant graphs in 2025. The proof combines an exact Fourier reduction and complementary duality with a positive interior smoothing that reveals a nonlinear random fixed-point equation. To analyze this equation under the strong dependence of the distance-bit model, we construct canonical tree fields, establish growing-degree Gaussian approximations through polynomial comparison and Wick/Hermite expansions, and transfer the resulting approximation back to the original sign model. A deterministic residual estimate together with an explicit exceptional-event integration yields the sharp expectation asymptotics.
items.authors: Xin Chen, Hongwei Hu, Yanqing Hu, Wei Wang, Luzhen Yang
items.title_zh: 随机循环图 Lov\'asz 数的锐渐近
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究由循环距离索引的独立伯努利位生成的密集随机循环图的 LOV\'ASZ 数。尽管只有 $O(n)$ 独立随机输入确定 $O(n^2)$ 全局相关边缘指标，但我们证明了沿着所有奇数阶（包括复合阶）的尖锐期望渐近，且具有前导常量 1。这解决了对 2025 年随机循环图提出的猜想。该证明将精确的傅立叶约简和互补对偶性与揭示非线性随机定点方程的正内部平滑相结合。为了在距离位模型的强依赖性下分析该方程，我们构造了规范树域，通过多项式比较和 Wick/Hermite 展开建立了生长度高斯近似，并将所得近似传递回原始符号模型。确定性残差估计与显式异常事件积分一起产生锐期望渐近。

items.title: Optimized linear multistep methods for stiff problems
items.excerpt: We design and test several new optimized linear multistep methods for stiff problems. Each method is A-stable, implicit, and second-order accurate. We focus on achieving the smallest possible error constant while also ensuring that stiff modes are damped. We recover some known optimal L-stable three- and four-step methods, and provide new and improved five-step methods. We also develop new methods that are not L-stable but provide a prescribed rate of damping in the infinitely stiff limit. Variable-step-size formulae are also provided for some of the new methods. Numerical tests demonstrate that the improved error constants lead to improved accuracy.
items.authors: Tyler Jensen, David I Ketcheson, Lajos L\'oczi
items.title_zh: 刚性问题的优化线性多步方法
items.excerpt_zh: 我们设计并测试了几种新的优化线性多步方法来解决刚性问题。每种方法都是 A 稳定、隐式和二阶准确的。我们专注于实现尽可能最小的误差常数，同时确保刚性模式得到阻尼。我们恢复了一些已知的最佳 L 稳定三步和四步方法，并提供了新的和改进的五步方法。我们还开发了非 L 稳定但在无限刚度极限下提供规定阻尼率的新方法。还为一些新方法提供了变步长公式。数值测试表明，改进的误差常数可以提高精度。

items.title: Geometric multigrid preconditioners for unfitted discretisations of the de Rham complex
items.excerpt: We propose two families of multigrid preconditioners for unfitted finite element discretisations of the Riesz maps of the de Rham complex, in H(grad), H(curl) and H(div), stabilised by cell aggregation. The first is a geometric multigrid method applied directly to the unfitted operators, on a hierarchy of background meshes that share the same boundary representation. Its smoothers are star patches built on the aggregated mesh, so that each patch captures the kernel of the stabilisation. The second is a multilevel auxiliary-space preconditioner that combines a patch smoother localised around the cut cells with the body-fitted problem on the active mesh, which is in turn solved by a non-nested geometric multigrid method. Both are used as building blocks of block-diagonal preconditioners for the mixed Hodge Laplacians. Numerical experiments in two and three dimensions, on geometries with a controlled cut fraction and on general geometries, show iteration counts that are robust with respect to the cut configuration, the mesh size and the number of levels. We also report results for higher-order discretisations, weakly imposed Dirichlet bo
items.title_zh: 用于 de Rham 复合体不拟合离散化的几何多重网格预处理器
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了两个多重网格预处理器系列，用于 de Rham 复形的 Riesz 图的不拟合有限元离散化，以 H(grad)、H(curl) 和 H(div) 形式，通过单元聚合进行稳定。第一种是在共享相同边界表示的背景网格层次结构上直接应用于未拟合算子的几何多重网格方法。它的平滑器是建立在聚合网格上的星形补丁，因此每个补丁都捕获稳定的核心。第二个是多级辅助空间预处理器，它将切割单元周围局部的补丁平滑器与活动网格上的身体拟合问题相结合，然后通过非嵌套几何多重网格方法来解决。两者都用作混合霍奇拉普拉斯块对角预处理器的构建块。在二维和三维、具有受控切割分数的几何形状和一般几何形状上的数值实验表明，迭代计数在切割配置、网格尺寸和层数方面是稳健的。我们还报告了高阶离散化、弱施加 Dirichlet bo 的结果

items.title: Geometry-Aware Latent Representation Learning for Drag Coefficient Prediction of Irregular Particles
items.excerpt: Predicting the drag coefficient $C_\mathrm{d}$ of irregular particles requires representing their complex three-dimensional geometry in a form suitable for predictive models. Empirical drag correlations and many data-driven models represent particle geometry through a small set of hand-crafted shape descriptors. Geometric differences omitted by these descriptors are unavailable to the predictor. We propose a variational autoencoder-multilayer perceptron (VAE-MLP) framework that learns a latent representation directly from voxelized particle geometry. Geometry reconstruction and drag coefficient prediction jointly guide the learning of this representation. We compare VAE-MLP with a descriptor-based MLP (Descriptor-MLP) and established empirical correlations using CFD data for synthetic particle geometries at Reynolds numbers of 10--200. When the evaluated geometric variations are represented in the training data, the two learned models achieve comparable accuracy for regular ellipsoids, while VAE-MLP yields lower errors for irregular particles. items.authors: Zihao Li, Shota Deguchi, Mitsuteru Asai, Shunhua Chen, Naoto Mitsume
items.title_zh: 用于不规则颗粒阻力系数预测的几何感知潜在表示学习
items.excerpt_zh: 预测不规则颗粒的阻力系数 $C_\mathrm{d}$ 需要以适合预测模型的形式表示其复杂的三维几何形状。经验阻力相关性和许多数据驱动模型通过一小组手工制作的形状描述符来表示粒子几何形状。这些描述符忽略的几何差异对于预测器来说是不可用的。我们提出了一种变分自动编码器-多层感知器（VAE-MLP）框​​架，该框架直接从体素化粒子几何结构中学习潜在表示。几何重建和阻力系数预测共同指导这种表示的学习。我们将 VAE-MLP 与基于描述符的 MLP (Descriptor-MLP) 进行比较，并使用 CFD 数据建立雷诺数为 10--200 的合成粒子几何形状的经验相关性。当评估的几何变化在训练数据中表示时，两个学习模型对于规则椭球体达到了相当的精度，而 VAE-MLP 对于不规则粒子产生较低的误差。当从训练中排除高阶表面扰动时，VAE-MLP 实现了较低的overve

items.title: Stability and Error Estimates for Convolution Quadrature under Radial Symbol Bounds
items.excerpt: We develop stability and error estimates for multistep convolution quadrature (CQ) under general radial bounds on the Laplace symbol. Instead of the classical single-power condition $|F(z)|\leq M|z|^{-\mu}$, we assume $|F(z)|\leq C\Phi(|z|)$ and consider two classes of radial functions: monotone bounds satisfying a scaling condition and regularly varying bounds with locally bounded above and away from zero. For strongly $A(\alpha)$-stable multistep methods, we derive approximation and stability estimates for the CQ weights, as well as error bounds for power-type inputs $g_\beta(t)=t^{\beta-1}/\Gamma(\beta)$ with $\beta>0$. These estimates explicitly retain the dependence on the memory law through the factor $\Phi(t_n^{-1})$. The framework accommodates symbols whose behavior cannot be described by a global single-power. It also preserves slowly varying and multiscale factors that would be lost under a coarser power majorant. The theory is applied to fractional viscoelastic models, distributed-order operators, and logarithmic-power memory operators. items.title_zh: 径向符号界限下卷积求积的稳定性和误差估计
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在拉普拉斯符号的一般径向边界下开发了多步卷积求积（CQ）的稳定性和误差估计。我们假设 $|F(z)|\leq C\Phi(|z|)$ 代替经典的单幂条件 $|F(z)|\leq M|z|^{-\mu}$ ，并考虑两类径向函数：满足缩放条件的单调边界和局部有界于零上方和远离零的规则变化边界。对于强 $A(\alpha)$ 稳定的多步方法，我们推导出 CQ 权重的近似和稳定性估计，以及幂类型输入 $g_\beta(t)=t^{\beta-1}/\Gamma(\beta)$ 的误差界限，其中 $\beta>0$。这些估计通过因子 $\Phi(t_n^{-1})$ 明确保留了对记忆法则的依赖。该框架容纳了其行为无法用全球单一权力来描述的符号。它还保留了缓慢变化和多尺度的因素，这些因素在较粗的权力主导下会丢失。该理论适用于分数粘弹性模型、分布阶算子和对数幂记忆算子。向后欧拉和二阶向后微分 CQ c 的数值实验

items.title: Nondimensionalization, Variational Inequalities and Uncertainty Quantification in a Morphoelastic Model for Burn Injury Healing
items.excerpt: Mathematical modelling of burn injury healing involves coupling biological processes with mechanical deformation, resulting in computationally stiff, nonlinear partial differential equations that severely limit the scalability of existing numerical solutions. We present a computational framework addressing these challenges. By nondimensionalizing the model and performing scaling analysis, we show that chemotaxis and inertia are negligible, permitting a quasi-static momentum approach. To enforce non-negativity constraints, we implement a Variational Inequality formulation using the Finite Element Method in FEniCSx, and verify it via numerical convergence studies and mass balances. We identify high-order parameter interactions, specifically equilibrium collagen density and signalling dynamics, as the primary drivers of solver stability. A sensitivity analysis of nearly four million simulations reveals that isolated parameter variations predominantly govern the maximum wound contraction. items.title_zh: 烧伤愈合形态弹性模型中的无量纲化、变分不等式和不确定性量化
items.excerpt_zh: 烧伤愈合的数学建模涉及将生物过程与机械变形耦合，导致计算僵化的非线性偏微分方程，严重限制了现有数值解的可扩展性。我们提出了一个解决这些挑战的计算框架。通过对模型进行无量纲化并进行尺度分析，我们表明趋化性和惯性可以忽略不计，从而允许采用准静态动量方法。为了强制执行非负约束，我们使用 FEniCSx 中的有限元方法实施变分不等式公式，并通过数值收敛研究和质量平衡对其进行验证。我们确定高阶参数相互作用，特别是平衡胶原密度和信号动力学，作为求解器稳定性的主要驱动因素。对近四百万次模拟的敏感性分析表明，孤立的参数变化主要控制最大伤口收缩。相反，高阶相互作用决定最大收缩和永久挛缩的时间。然而，没有显着的成对参数

items.title: Multilevel Gaussian Processes with Applications to Inverse Problems
items.excerpt: We present a multilevel Gaussian process (GP) regression framework for approximating functions that are accessible only through a hierarchy of approximations of increasing accuracy and computational cost. One example is the response surface of a parametrized partial differential equation, where the hierarchy arises from the resolution of the numerical solver. Modeling level increments independently with Mat\'ern-kernel GPs and allocating samples flexibly across discretization levels yields substantial computational savings over single-level GP regression. We derive $L^2$ convergence rates for the posterior mean and variance, accounting for maximum likelihood estimation of the marginal variance and for kernel misspecification. When increment regularity or solver cost is unknown a priori, an adaptive sequential-design algorithm with cost-adapted active learning criteria allocates samples across levels. We apply the surrogate to Bayesian inverse problems, for which Hellinger distance bounds between the true and approximate posteriors are known. items.authors: Stjepan Salatovic, Aretha L. Teckentrup, Sebastian Krumscheid
items.title_zh: 多级高斯过程及其在反问题中的应用
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一个多级高斯过程（GP）回归框架，用于逼近函数，该框架只能通过增加精度和计算成本的逼近层次来访问。一个例子是参数化偏微分方程的响应面，其中层次结构由数值求解器的分辨率产生。与 Mat\'ern 内核 GP 独立地建模级别增量，并跨离散化级别灵活分配样本，与单级 GP 回归相比，可节省大量计算量。我们得出后验均值和方差的 $L^2$ 收敛率，考虑了边际方差的最大似然估计和核错误指定。当增量规律性或求解器成本先验未知时，具有适应成本的主动学习标准的自适应顺序设计算法会跨级别分配样本。我们将代理应用于贝叶斯反问题，其中真实后验和近似后验之间的海林格距离界限是已知的。数值实验说明了理论速率和由此产生的计算节省

items.title: A configurational numerical viscosity for thermodynamically compatible finite volume schemes of compressible multiphase flows
items.excerpt: We consider the fluid subsystem of a variationally derived hyperbolic thermodynamically compatible (HTC) model of compressible multiphase flows. Its total energy is in general not convex in the natural state variables, so a scalar numerical viscosity acting on them need not produce non-negative entropy. Reformulating the equations in terms of the volume fractions separates changes in the amount of each phase from changes in its intrinsic state. This guides the construction of a configurational numerical viscosity in phase variables, in which the energy is convex, while the scheme retains the structure of the HTC model. At the semi-discrete level, the new schemes satisfy: I) local conservation of the phase masses, the mixture momentum and the total energy; II) a cell entropy inequality whose production is non-negative face by face and phase by phase, with no convexity assumption in the evolved variables and no clipping; III) positivity of the partial densities and volume fractions under explicit time-step conditions; IV) exact preservation of contact equilibria; V) equivalence with a scheme for the density-weighted volume fractions. items.authors: Davide Ferrari, Ilya Peshkov, Michael Dumbser
items.title_zh: 可压缩多相流热力学相容有限体积方案的构型数值粘度
items.excerpt_zh: 我们考虑可压缩多相流的变分导出双曲热力学兼容 (HTC) 模型的流体子系统。它的总能量在自然状态变量中通常不是凸的，因此作用于它们的标量数值粘度不需要产生非负熵。根据体积分数重新制定方程，将各相量的变化与其固有状态的变化分开。这指导了相变量中构型数值粘度的构造，其中能量是凸的，同时该方案保留了 HTC 模型的结构。在半离散层面，新方案满足： I) 相质量、混合动量和总能量的局部守恒； II) 细胞熵不等式，其产生逐面、逐相非负，演化变量没有凸性假设，也没有剪裁； III) 在明确的时间步长条件下，部分密度和体积分数的正值； IV) 精确保持接触平衡； V) 与密度加权体积分数方案等效。钍

items.title: Quasi-Monte Carlo based meshfree methods for parabolic equations on parameterized Riemannian manifolds
items.excerpt: We develop and analyze a randomized path sampling framework for the pointwise approximation of linear parabolic equations on parameterized Riemannian manifolds, treating both closed manifolds and manifolds with Dirichlet boundary. Based on the Feynman-Kac representation, we construct a parameter-coordinate retraction-based discretization, referred to as the p-Ret scheme, for the manifold diffusion generated by the uniformly elliptic operator, and use it to formulate the Monte Carlo (MC) and randomized quasi-Monte Carlo (RQMC) methods. We derive the local weak consistency of the p-Ret transition and first-order weak convergence of the temporal discretization on closed manifolds. For fixed $h$, we show that RQMC sampling yields asymptotically faster variance decay than standard MC. On closed manifolds, the variance is $o(n^{-1})$ and, under additional regularity, satisfies the sharper bound $O(n^{-2+\varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon>0$. items.title_zh: 基于准蒙特卡罗的参数化黎曼流形上抛物线方程的无网格方法
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发并分析了一个随机路径采样框架，用于参数化黎曼流形上线性抛物线方程的逐点逼近，处理闭流形和狄利克雷边界流形。基于Feynman-Kac表示，我们针对均匀椭圆算子生成的流形扩散构造了基于参数坐标回缩的离散化（称为p-Ret方案），并用它来制定蒙特卡罗（MC）和随机拟蒙特卡罗（RQMC）方法。我们推导了闭流形上 p-Ret 转换的局部弱一致性和时间离散化的一阶弱收敛性。对于固定的 $h$，我们表明 RQMC 采样比标准 MC 产生渐近更快的方差衰减。在闭流形上，方差为 $o(n^{-1})$，并且在附加正则性下，对于任何 $\varepsilon>0$ 满足更尖锐的界限 $O(n^{-2+\varepsilon})$。对于狄利克雷问题，尽管数值第一次退出引起了不连续性，但对于任何 $\varepsilon>0$ 在

items.title: Model completeness for the differential field of transseries with exponentiation
items.excerpt: We show that the expansion of the valued differential field of logarithmic-exponential transseries by its natural exponential function is model complete. We give an axiomatization of the theory of this expansion that is effective relative to the theory of the real exponential field, and show that any maximal Hardy field satisfies the same axioms. We use this to prove a transfer theorem between Hardy fields and transseries.
items.title_zh: 带幂的跨系列微分场的模型完整性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，对数指数跨列的值微分域通过其自然指数函数的展开是模型完备的。我们给出了这种展开理论的公理化，该理论相对于实指数域的理论是有效的，并证明任何最大哈迪域都满足相同的公理。我们用它来证明哈代场和跨系列之间的传递定理。

items.title: Schnorr Randomness and Effective Bayesian Consistency and Inconsistency
items.excerpt: We study Doob's Consistency Theorem and Freedman's Inconsistency Theorem from the vantage point of computable probability and algorithmic randomness. We show that the Schnorr random elements of the parameter space are computably consistent, when there is a map from the sample space to the parameter space satisfying many of the same properties as limiting relative frequencies. We show that the generic inconsistency in Freedman's Theorem is effectively comeager, which implies the existence of computable parameters which are not computably consistent. Taken together, this work provides a computability-theoretic solution to Diaconis and Freedman's problem of ``know[ing] for which [parameters] the rule [Bayes' rule] is consistent'', and it strengthens recent similar results of Takahashi on Martin-L\"of randomness in Cantor space.
items.authors: Simon M. Huttegger, Sean Walsh, Francesca Zaffora Blando
items.title_zh: Schnorr 随机性和有效贝叶斯一致性和不一致性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们从可计算概率和算法随机性的角度研究 Doob 一致性定理和 Freedman 不一致性定理。我们证明，当存在从样本空间到参数空间的映射满足许多与限制相对频率相同的属性时，参数空间的 Schnorr 随机元素是可计算一致的。我们证明弗里德曼定理中的一般不一致性实际上是comager，这意味着存在不可计算一致的可计算参数。总而言之，这项工作为 Diaconis 和 Freedman 的“知道哪些[参数]规则[贝叶斯规则]是一致的”问题提供了可计算性的理论解决方案，并且它强化了 Takahashi 最近关于 Cantor 空间随机性的 Martin-L 的类似结果。

items.title: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
items.excerpt: Enhancing the agentic capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex software engineering (SWE) and general terminal-usage problems is a pressing challenge. Current state-of-the-art LLMs often go through large-scale agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, they mostly rely on high-level outcome rewards, with minimal consideration of low-level toolcall and mid-level workflow-stage rewards, which makes the training less effective. To overcome this limitation, we propose **Lean4AgenticRL**, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first framework that grounds multi-level process rewards in the unified Lean4 formalization schema for open-ended agentic RL. **Lean4AgenticRL** first builds a *problem-specific workflow* system that balances the agent's own capability and controllability during execution, laying the foundation for further verification. Subsequently, our workflow formalization and multi-level reward annotation methods enable agent behavior verification within a general harness system. It provides multi-level rewards to support more effective agentic RL with the workflow-stage-normalized GRPO algorithm. U
items.authors: Ruida Wang, Gerald Friedland, Tong Zhang, Chris Kong
items.title_zh: Lean4AgenticRL：通过可验证的多级流程奖励推进代理强化学习
items.excerpt_zh: 增强大型语言模型（LLM）的代理能力以解决复杂的软件工程（SWE）和一般终端使用问题是一项紧迫的挑战。当前最先进的法学硕士通常会经历大规模代理强化学习（RL）。然而，他们主要依赖于高层结果奖励，很少考虑低层工具调用和中层工作流程阶段奖励，这使得培训效果较差。为了克服这一限制，我们提出 **Lean4AgenticRL**，据我们所知，这是第一个将多级过程奖励建立在开放式代理强化学习的统一 Lean4 形式化模式中的框架。 **Lean4AgenticRL**首先构建了一个“针对特定问题的工作流程”系统，平衡了智能体自身的能力和执行过程中的可控性，为进一步验证奠定了基础。随后，我们的工作流程形式化和多级奖励注释方法使得能够在通用线束系统内验证代理行为。它提供多级奖励，通过工作流阶段归一化 GRPO 算法支持更有效的代理强化学习。 U

items.title: Batched Contextual Reinforcement II: Does RLVR Need Long Rollout Windows?
items.excerpt: Long rollout windows make reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) expensive, yet simply shortening them can remove the correctness signal: when every single-problem rollout truncates before an answer, group-relative accuracy advantages vanish. As a technical continuation of Batched Contextual Reinforcement (BCR), we study how concurrent rewards relax this dependence on long windows. Concurrent Constraint Reinforcement (CCR) places three independently verifiable problems in one capped training completion. Correct answers completed before truncation retain credit, while a shared budget encourages shorter useful reasoning without an explicit length penalty. We connect this mechanism to conditional reward- and update-variance analyses and study 4B and 8B mathematical reasoning models. Against single-problem GRPO with a 32k window, CCR with an 8,000-token window reduces tokens per training step from 975,464 to 174,957 on 4B and from 793,832 to 165,788 on 8B, saving 82.1% and 79.1%, respectively. items.title_zh: 批量上下文强化 II：RLVR 是否需要较长的推出窗口？
items.excerpt_zh: 较长的推出窗口使得具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）成本高昂，但简单地缩短它们可以消除正确性信号：当每个单一问题的推出在答案之前截断时，相对于组的准确性优势就会消失。作为批量上下文强化（BCR）的技术延续，我们研究并发奖励如何缓解这种对长窗口的依赖。并发约束强化 (CCR) 在一次有上限的训练完成中放置了三个可独立验证的问题。在截断之前完成的正确答案保留学分，而共享预算则鼓励更短的有用推理，而不会受到明确的长度惩罚。我们将此机制与条件奖励和更新方差分析联系起来，并研究 4B 和 8B 数学推理模型。与具有 32k 窗口的单问题 GRPO 相比，具有 8,000 个令牌窗口的 CCR 将每个训练步骤的令牌在 4B 上从 975,464 减少到 174,957，在 8B 上从 793,832 减少到 165,788，分别节省了 82.1% 和 79.1%。 8B 训练轨迹显示准确性奖励不断增加，但完成时间较短。单问题评估提供支持 e

items.title: "Deep lifts": Neural networks can generalize even with the dumbest optimizer
items.excerpt: Given a labeled dataset $\{(x_i, y_i)\}_{i = 1}^n$, consider drawing a parameter vector $\hat{\theta}$ uniformly at random from those that interpolate the data within a width-$W$ depth-$D$ ReLU architecture with continuous weights bounded within $[-M, M]$. We study the generalization properties of $\hat{\theta}$ in the case where the dataset can, in fact, be explained by a smaller $w$-by-$d$ ReLU network. Despite the obliviousness of the selection rule for $\hat{\theta}$, it adaptively generalizes at the rate $\tilde O\left(\frac{wdWD}{n}\right)$, rather than being governed by the VC dimension of the full $W$-by-$D$ hypothesis class. The reason is due to a particular inductive bias in ReLU networks: the $w$-by-$d$ parameter *witnesses* an exponential volume of $W$-by-$D$ interpolating parameters, which dwarfs the volume of poorly generalizing parameters (conditioned on interpolation). We explicitly construct this set of near-equivalent $W$-by-$D$ parameters by a proof technique called *deep lifting*, and then tie the achievable volume to stability properties of the $w$-by-$d$ witness.
