items.excerpt_zh: 给定一个标记数据集 $\{(x_i, y_i)\}_{i = 1}^n$，考虑从那些在宽度 - $W$ 深度 - $D$ ReLU 架构内插值数据的参数向量均匀地随机绘制一个参数向量 $\hat{\theta}$ ，连续权重在 $[-M, M]$ 范围内。我们研究了 $\hat{\theta}$ 的泛化属性，其中数据集实际上可以通过较小的 $w$-by-$d$ ReLU 网络来解释。尽管$\hat{\theta}$的选择规则被遗忘，但它以$\tilde O\left(\frac{wdWD}{n}\right)$的速率自适应地概括，而不是受整个$W$-by-$D$假设类的VC维控制。原因是 ReLU 网络中存在特殊的归纳偏差：$w$-by-$d$ 参数*见证*了 $W$-by-$D$ 插值参数的指数量，这使得泛化能力较差的参数量（以插值为条件）相形见绌。我们通过称为“深度提升”的证明技术显式构造这组近乎等效的 $W$-by-$D$ 参数，然后将可实现的交易量与 $w$-by-$d$ 见证人的稳定性属性联系起来。例子表明这些技术使我们能够

items.title: GR-OPD: Group-Relative Sequence Credit for On-Policy Distillation
items.excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides token-level teacher feedback, yet common sampled-token updates assign credit locally and omit the effects of earlier actions on subsequent feedback. We introduce \method{} (Group-Relative On-Policy Distillation), which decouples feedback computation from credit assignment by aggregating token feedback into calibrated sequence-level credit. We establish a theoretical basis for this approach by showing that, under ideal on-policy assumptions, broadcasting raw summed feedback to every response token yields an unbiased estimate of the negative gradient of the sequence-level reverse-KL objective. To support effective learning in practice, \method{} discounts later feedback that may become less reliable under distribution shift and uses same-prompt rollout groups to calibrate teacher guidance. It preserves relative response preferences while retaining a controlled fraction of the group mean, which we term collective teacher pressure. Across five Qwen3 teacher--student settings and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, \method{} outperforms vanilla OPD in macro Avg@K in every setting, including gains of
items.authors: Yushu Wang, Renkai Yang, Jingcao Xu, Zili Geng, Haihong Tang, Yaohui Jin, Hao He
items.title_zh: GR-OPD：按策略蒸馏的组相对序列信用
items.excerpt_zh: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）提供令牌级别的教师反馈，但常见的采样令牌更新在本地分配信用并忽略早期操作对后续反馈的影响。我们引入了 \method{}（组相对论策略蒸馏），它通过将令牌反馈聚合到校准的序列级信用中，将反馈计算与信用分配解耦。我们通过证明在理想的策略假设下，向每个响应令牌广播原始汇总反馈可以产生序列级反向 KL 目标的负梯度的无偏估计，为这种方法奠定了理论基础。为了支持实践中的有效学习，\method{} 折扣了在分布转移下可能变得不太可靠的后续反馈，并使用相同提示的推出组来校准教师指导。它保留了相对反应偏好，同时保留了群体平均值的受控部分，我们称之为集体教师压力。在五个 Qwen3 教师-学生设置和六个数学推理基准测试中，\method{} 在每个设置中都优于宏观 Avg@K 中的普通 OPD，包括

items.title: Where Latents Belong and How They Flow: Joint Identification of Structural Roles
items.excerpt: Latent factors in dynamical systems can play different roles across observations and time. For example, an idea in a group meeting may be expressed by only some participants, inherit information from earlier discussions, and shape what is said next. We formalize this notion as the structural role of a latent factor, describing where it is expressed, whether it receives influence from the past, and whether it transmits influence to the future. The main challenge is correspondence, since the three structures may be identified under different permutations, while a structural role is defined only when they are aligned to the same latent coordinate. We show that, under suitable structural and variability conditions, all three roles are jointly identifiable under a common permutation at each time point. Guided by this theory, we develop RoleTrace, a framework that traces structural roles in a shared latent coordinate system. Synthetic experiments validate structural recovery, while experiments on multiparty meetings examine the identified roles in real sequential interactions.
items.authors: Xintong Li, Kun Zhang, Yujia Zheng
items.title_zh: 潜伏者属于哪里以及它们如何流动：结构角色的联合识别
items.excerpt_zh: 动力系统中的潜在因素可以在不同的观察和时间中发挥不同的作用。例如，小组会议中的一个想法可能只有一些参与者表达，继承之前讨论的信息，并形成接下来要说的内容。我们将这个概念形式化为潜在因素的结构作用，描述它在哪里表达，它是否受到过去的影响，以及它是否将影响传递到未来。主要的挑战是对应性，因为这三个结构可以在不同的排列下被识别，而只有当它们与相同的潜在坐标对齐时才定义结构角色。我们表明，在适当的结构和变异条件下，所有三个角色在每个时间点的共同排列下都是可共同识别的。在这一理论的指导下，我们开发了 RoleTrace，一个在共享潜在坐标系中跟踪结构角色的框架。综合实验验证结构恢复，而多方会议实验则检查真实顺序交互中已识别的角色。

items.title: Anisotropic Representation Dynamics in Transformers
items.excerpt: Small differences between internal representations can shrink or grow as they pass through a Transformer layer, affecting how information is preserved and how sensitive the model is to perturbations. Yet it remains unclear when changes in attention weights can turn a representation difference that would otherwise shrink into one that grows. We develop a \textbf{Mixture-Gated Theory of Anisotropic Representation Dynamics} that separates self-attention into value transport, query gating, and key gating. Our analysis reveals how the geometry of attended representations constrains gating and how interactions between these mechanisms can reverse contraction induced by value transport. We formalize this phenomenon as gating-induced regime switching, where a representation difference contracts under fixed attention routing but expands under full attention. We derive a necessary and sufficient spectral criterion that certifies the existence or absence of switching and identifies switching directions without exhaustive search. Beyond existence, our theory characterizes maximum relative switching strength, certifies the severity of contraction
items.title_zh: 变压器中的各向异性表示动力学
items.excerpt_zh: 内部表示之间的微小差异在通过 Transformer 层时可能会缩小或增大，从而影响信息的保存方式以及模型对扰动的敏感度。然而，目前尚不清楚注意力权重的变化何时能够将表征差异转化为更大的表征差异。我们开发了一种 \textbf{各向异性表示动力学的混合门控理论}，它将自注意力分为值传输、查询门控和键门控。我们的分析揭示了参与表示的几何形状如何限制门控，以及这些机制之间的相互作用如何逆转价值传输引起的收缩。我们将这种现象形式化为门控诱导的政权切换，其中表征差异在固定注意力路由下收缩，但在充分注意力下扩展。我们推导出一个必要且充分的谱标准，该标准可以证明切换是否存在，并无需穷举搜索即可识别切换方向。除了存在之外，我们的理论还描述了最大相对转换强度，证明了收缩的严重程度

items.title: Sample, Mix, or Verify? Allocating Test-Time Compute under Imperfect Verifiers
items.excerpt: A common way to make language models and agents more accurate is to spend more compute at inference time: generate many candidate solutions and submit the one a verifier prefers. Success then requires that some candidate is correct and that the verifier picks it. The first grows predictably with the number of samples; the second does not, because real verifiers (unit tests, majority votes, LLM judges, reward models) accept wrong answers, reject right ones, and make correlated mistakes. With a fixed budget, a practitioner must decide how many samples to draw, which models to draw them from, and how much to spend on verification, and today these choices are made by rules of thumb. We introduce SPLIT, which makes them from a small labelled pilot. It rests on an exact formula for the probability of submitting a correct answer under accept/reject and top-score selection that accounts for varying task difficulty, blind spots shared across models, and correlated repeated verifier calls. SPLIT fits the formula by empirical Bayes and uses it to plan budgets on unseen tasks. Across seven benchmarks spanning math, science QA, code and software-e
items.title_zh: 取样、混合或验证？在不完美验证器下分配测试时计算
items.excerpt_zh: 使语言模型和代理更加准确的一种常见方法是在推理时花费更多计算：生成许多候选解决方案并提交验证者喜欢的解决方案。成功需要某个候选者是正确的并且验证者选择它。第一个随着样本数量的增加而增长；第二个则不然，因为真正的验证者（单元测试、多数票、LLM 法官、奖励模型）接受错误的答案，拒绝正确的答案，并犯相关错误。在预算固定的情况下，从业者必须决定抽取多少样本、从哪些模型中抽取样本以及在验证上花费多少钱，而今天这些选择都是根据经验法则做出的。我们引入了 SPLIT，这使得它们来自于一个小的标签飞行员。它依赖于在接受/拒绝和最高分选择下提交正确答案的概率的精确公式，该公式考虑了不同的任务难度、跨模型共享的盲点以及相关的重复验证者调用。 SPLIT 符合经验贝叶斯公式，并用它来规划看不见的任务的预算。涵盖数学、科学 QA、代码和软件等七个基准

items.title: Pearl-Chat: Engineering a native Luganda language model from first principles in JAX and Flax NNX
items.excerpt: Autoregressive foundation language models predominantly target high-resource Indo-European languages, imposing computational and morphological penalties on under-represented African languages. Generic multilingual tokenizers routinely exceed fertility rates of 3.2 tokens per word on agglutinative Bantu languages, degrading context efficiency and inflating latency. We present Pearl-Chat, an 8,473,122-parameter ($\sim$8.5M) causal decoder-only transformer engineered for Luganda (Oluganda, ISO 639-2: lg), a low-resource Niger-Congo Bantu language spoken by over 10 million people in East Africa. Built from first mathematical principles in JAX and Flax NNX, Pearl-Chat uses explicit functional state decomposition (nnx.split and nnx.merge), deterministic resumable data streaming via Google Grain, and SPMD tensor parallelism using jax.sharding.Mesh. We introduce a byte-level byte-pair encoding (BPE) subword tokenizer trained from scratch on curated Luganda corpora ($V = 8,192$), achieving 4.88 characters per token compression and 1.60 tokens per word fertility, a two-fold compression improvement over LLaMA-3 (128K) and Gemma (256K). The model
items.title_zh: Pearl-Chat：根据 JAX 和 Flax NNX 的第一原理设计原生卢干达语言模型
items.excerpt_zh: 自回归基础语言模型主要针对资源丰富的印欧语言，对代表性不足的非洲语言施加计算和形态惩罚。在粘性班图语中，通用多语言分词器通常会超过每个单词 3.2 个分词的生育率，从而降低了上下文效率并增加了延迟。我们推出了 Pearl-Chat，这是一个 8,473,122 个参数（$\sim$850 万）的因果解码器专用变压器，专为卢干达语（Oluganda，ISO 639-2：lg）设计，卢干达语是一种资源匮乏的尼日尔-刚果班图语，东非有超过 1000 万人使用。 Pearl-Chat 基于 JAX 和 Flax NNX 中的第一数学原理构建，使用显式功能状态分解（nnx.split 和 nnx.merge）、通过 Google Grain 的确定性可恢复数据流以及使用 jax.sharding.Mesh 的 SPMD 张量并行性。我们引入了一种字节级字节对编码 (BPE) 子词分词器，在精心策划的 Luganda 语料库 ($V = 8,192$) 上从头开始训练，实现了每个标记压缩 4.88 个字符和每个单词 1.60 个标记，比 LLaMA-3 (128K) 和 Gemma (256K) 压缩提高了两倍。型号

items.title: Causal Edit Serialization
items.excerpt: Standard autoregressive language models generate text sequentially, but revision requires referring back to tokens in the input context or those already generated. Causal Edit Serialization (CES) is introduced as a framework for expressing such revisions within the same causal token stream. Special pointer tokens are paired with predicted source addresses, allowing insertion, deletion, replacement, copying and movement to be localized explicitly. A lightweight localization head and dual-index rotary position encoding support both address prediction and conditioning on previously emitted pointers, while retaining a standard causal attention mask. A pretraining procedure combines ordinary language modeling with serialized repairs derived from random corruptions, model-generated edits and repeated text. Across model scales and editing baselines, CES models demonstrate complete applied edits with modestly higher clean-text bits per byte than clean autoregressive models. Supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training provide a grammatical-error-correction proof of concept, producing more beneficial than harmful changes under reference
items.title_zh: 因果编辑序列化
items.excerpt_zh: 标准自回归语言模型按顺序生成文本，但修订需要引用输入上下文中的标记或已生成的标记。因果编辑序列化 (CES) 被引入作为在同一因果标记流中表达此类修订的框架。特殊的指针标记与预测的源地址配对，允许显式本地化插入、删除、替换、复制和移动。轻量级定位头和双索引旋转位置编码支持地址预测和对先前发出的指针的调节，同时保留标准因果注意掩模。预训练过程将普通语言建模与源自随机损坏、模型生成的编辑和重复文本的序列化修复相结合。在模型规模和编辑基线上，CES 模型展示了完整的应用编辑，每字节的干净文本位数比干净的自回归模型稍高。监督和强化学习后训练提供了概念的语法错误纠正证明，在参考下产生有益多于有害的变化

items.title: Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation for Efficient LLM Tree Search
items.excerpt: Tree search enhances multi-step reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet prevailing methods expand every step with a fixed budget, irrespective of the marginal utility of expansion. We first show, across existing search algorithms, that continuations sampled from a shared intermediate state are largely duplicates and collapse to a few distinct answers. Critically, we find that the semantic dispersion of sibling actions predicts the redundancy of their downstream continuations, permitting a subtree's budget to be fixed before expansion. An information-theoretic analysis motivates this: treating the per-step budget as the Monte Carlo sample size for estimating a step's residual answer entropy, we derive a sufficient budget that shrinks with sibling dispersion. We accordingly propose $\textbf{Uncertainty-Aware Allocation}$ (UAA), a training-free framework that decouples value from uncertainty: values determine which candidates are promising, while uncertainty, estimated from sibling dispersion at no additional model cost, determines how many merit expansion, via uncertainty-aware pruning and uncertainty-aware budgeting. Across math
items.authors: Jianguo Huang, Zhiyi Lyu, Fuxiang Zhang, Yanchen Deng, Deheng Ye, Bo An
items.title_zh: 用于高效 LLM 树搜索的不确定性预算分配
items.excerpt_zh: 树搜索增强了大型语言模型（LLM）中的多步骤推理，但流行的方法以固定预算扩展每一步，而不考虑扩展的边际效用。我们首先表明，在现有的搜索算法中，从共享中间状态采样的延续大部分是重复的，并且会崩溃为几个不同的答案。重要的是，我们发现同级动作的语义分散可以预测其下游延续的冗余，从而允许子树的预算在扩展之前固定。信息论分析激发了这一点：将每步预算视为蒙特卡罗样本大小来估计一步的剩余答案熵，我们得出了一个随着同级离散度而缩小的足够预算。因此，我们提出了 $\textbf{Uncertainty-Aware Allocation}$ (UAA)，这是一个免训练的框架，将价值与不确定性分离：价值决定了哪些候选者是有前途的，而不确定性是在不增加模型成本的情况下从兄弟分散度中估计出来的，通过不确定性感知修剪和不确定性预算来确定有多少优点扩展。跨越数学

items.title: Identify, Classify, Act: Per-Instruction Controlled Compliance for LLMs over External Data
items.excerpt: LLMs over external data face a per-instruction tension: a single document or tool return often interleaves legitimate directives with adversarial prompt injections, and the model must follow the former while rejecting the latter. Existing defenses suppress or trust all external instructions, collapsing the safety-utility frontier and forcing a choice between over-refusal and over-compliance. We argue the missing capability is \textbf{per-instruction credit attribution} and formalize it as External-Data Instruction Classification, an identify-classify-act decision over each embedded directive. We propose \textbf{EDIC}, a decomposed reward framework for per-instruction compliance. A scene-grounded pipeline injects mixed beneficial and harmful instructions with counterfactual filtering, while a generative judge is initialized by SFT and refined with GRPO to attribute compliance at the instruction level. The judge then produces a reward that separately encourages beneficial compliance and penalizes harmful compliance for RL training. Across two backbones and five benchmarks, EDIC improves both safety and utility over the strongest prior d
items.authors: Zesheng Shi, Xue Li, Chenrui Dai, Jing Li
items.title_zh: 识别、分类、行动：法学硕士对外部数据的每条指令受控合规性
items.excerpt_zh: 基于外部数据的法学硕士面临着每条指令的紧张：单个文档或工具返回经常将合法指令与对抗性提示注入交织在一起，并且模型必须遵循前者，同时拒绝后者。现有的防御措施会压制或信任所有外部指令，从而破坏安全性与实用性的边界，并迫使人们在过度拒绝和过度遵守之间做出选择。我们认为缺失的能力是 \textbf{每指令信用归因} 并将其形式化为外部数据指令分类，即对每个嵌入指令的识别-分类-行为决策。我们提出 \textbf{EDIC}，一个用于每条指令合规性的分解奖励框架。基于场景的管道通过反事实过滤注入有益和有害的混合指令，而生成判断则由 SFT 初始化并用 GRPO 细化，以在指令级别归因于合规性。然后，法官会针对 RL 训练颁发奖励，分别鼓励有益的遵守行为和惩罚有害的遵守行为。通过两个主干网和五个基准，EDIC 比之前最强的 d 方案提高了安全性和实用性

items.title: Bengali Hallucination Detection with Retrieval and Programs: A System Study
items.excerpt: Bengali hallucination detection must distinguish unsupported factual claims from incorrect reasoning, often without a supplied reference passage. We present and characterize an inference-only system that combines response-conditioned query rewriting, hybrid retrieval, and task-specific language-model judging. Six retrieval routes search question-answer and passage collections; a router directs each example to a 27B textual judge or a 14B agent that can compare retrieved answers, reason directly, or generate and execute Python. We characterize the system using version-specific code, saved predictions, execution traces, and corpus metadata from the Olikbochon challenge. Kaggle associates a displayed private macro-F1 of 0.956 with Version 2; its saved run processes 2,516 examples in 220.99 minutes on two T4 GPUs. Of 253 math-routed examples, 88 terminate through candidate matching, while execution traces expose 49 stderr-bearing run events across 35 examples. A later run changes six predictions despite identical core worker code. A bounded audit of 1,090 benchmark-related corpus records finds exact question or context overlap for 38 proc
items.title_zh: 孟加拉幻觉检测与检索和程序：系统研究
items.excerpt_zh: 孟加拉幻觉检测必须区分不受支持的事实主张和不正确的推理，通常没有提供参考段落。我们提出并描述了一个仅推理系统，该系统结合了响应条件查询重写、混合检索和特定于任务的语言模型判断。六种检索路径搜索问答和文章集；路由器将每个示例定向到 27B 文本判断器或 14B 代理，它们可以比较检索到的答案、直接推理或生成并执行 Python。我们使用特定于版本的代码、保存的预测、执行跟踪和来自 Olikbochon 挑战的语料库元数据来表征系统。 Kaggle 将显示的私有宏 F1 0.956 与版本 2 相关联；其保存的运行时间为 220.99 分钟，在两个 T4 GPU 上运行处理了 2,516 个示例。在 253 个数学路由示例中，88 个通过候选匹配终止，而执行跟踪则暴露了 35 个示例中的 49 个包含 stderr 的运行事件。尽管核心工作代码相同，但后来的运行改变了六个预测。对 1,090 条基准相关语料库记录的有限审计发现 38 个过程的确切问题或上下文重叠

items.title: FederatedBytes: Tokenizer-Free, Byte-Level Small Language Models for Efficient Multimodal Federated Learning
items.excerpt: Federated Learning (FL) is a powerful machine learning framework that allows building a global model from the contributions of multiple, distributed clients, while ensuring the privacy of their local data. However, its heavy computational and communication overheads challenge its use for contemporary AI workloads such as natural language processing (NLP) and multimodal analysis. For this reason, this paper presents a novel small language model that leverages byte-level text and multimodal data processing, enhanced by a linear attention mechanism, to enable manageable Federated Learning of NLP and multimodal analysis tasks. The proposed model, nicknamed FederatedBytes, manages to process text and any other data types, including images, by treating its input as a mere sequence of bytes, while its lean linear attention mechanism allows abating the overall memory and computational footprint. To prove the effectiveness of the proposed model we have carried out an extensive performance evaluation on sentiment analysis tasks in multilingual and multimodal settings over the Multilingual Amazon Reviews and ScienceQA datasets. items.title: Think More or Read More? A Token-Budget Theory of Reasoning with Shared Context
items.excerpt: Reasoning systems increasingly improve answers by incorporating additional context into the model's input, from multi-agent debate, where agents read their peers' responses, to self-refinement, where a model revisits its own drafts. In these systems, communication consumes context as one agent's output becomes another's input. We study the regime where token reading and generation draw on one fixed token window, so every token spent reading is a token that cannot be spent reasoning. We develop a \textbf{token-budget theory} that formalizes this trade-off, modeling accuracy as a function of the reasoning budget remaining after reading and aggregating votes with a Condorcet jury model that permits correlated errors. For multi-agent debate, the theory gives a closed-form prediction for the optimal number of agents. This quantity is estimated from single-agent measurements, allowing the optimal group size to be determined without running debate, and the same accounting extends to a heterogeneous set of different models. items.title: The Navier-Stokes Announcement: A case study in mathematical values
items.excerpt: On September 8, 2026, OpenAI announced a resolution of the Navier-Stokes problem. I had expected to feel excitement if a solution was announced. Instead, my reaction was one of grief and revulsion. I will use the announcement to explore the universal human desires that underlie my reaction, I hope in a fashion that will reach beyond mathematicians.

items.title: The Dialectical Theorem
items.excerpt: We consider the future of mathematics as a profession in a world where artificial intelligence may surpass human mathematicians in essentially every technical task. Through an informal dialogue, we explore why human mathematical expertise might nevertheless remain valuable, what kinds of expertise universities should cultivate, and how graduate education might adapt. We also discuss the institutional and economic uncertainties that threaten the continued existence of a thriving mathematical profession, even if the value of human mathematical understanding endures.
items.title_zh: 辩证法定理
items.excerpt_zh: 我们认为数学的未来是人工智能在几乎所有技术任务上都可能超越人类数学家的世界中的一种职业。通过非正式对话，我们探讨了为什么人类数学专业知识仍然有价值，大学应该培养什么样的专业知识，以及研究生教育如何适应。我们还讨论了制度和经济的不确定性，这些不确定性威胁着蓬勃发展的数学职业的持续存在，即使人类数学理解的价值持续存在。

items.title: A lower bound of 21 for 3 × 3 matrix multiplication over every field
items.excerpt: Proved · Algebraic complexity; exact bilinear complexity and tensor rank · with GPT-6 Astra (gpt-6-astra), with GPT-6 Sol (gpt-6-sol) used for part of the work · significance 30/100. For a field K, what is the smallest number r of products of input linear forms needed to multiply two arbitrary 3\times3 matrices exactly? Equivalently, how small can r be in an identity AB=\sum_{i=1}^{r}a_i(A)b_i(B)W_i holding for every pair A,B, with K-linear forms a_i,b_i and fixed matrices W_i? The minimum is the exact bilinear complexity R_K\langle3,3,3\rangle. Which lower bounds hold uniformly over all fields?

items.title: Dow–Tkachuk Question 4.8: pseudocomplete countable closures in C_p(X) force X to be a P-space
items.excerpt: Proved · General topology; $C_p$-theory · with ChatGPT Astra (proof); Claude Opus 5.5 (Lean formalization) · significance 8/100. Dow and Tkachuk asked (Question 4.8): assume that the closure of A is pseudocomplete for every countable A \subset C_p(X). Must the Tychonoff space X be a P-space? Here C_p(X) is the space of continuous real-valued functions on X with the topology of pointwise convergence, pseudocompleteness is in Oxtoby's sense (a sequence of \pi-bases along which every closure-nested choice has nonempty intersection), and a P-space is one in which every G_\delta set is open.
items.title_zh: Dow-Tkachuk 问题 4.8：C_p(X) 中的伪完全可数闭包迫使 X 成为 P 空间
items.excerpt_zh: 已证明·一般拓扑； $C_p$-理论 · 与 ChatGPT Astra（证明）； Claude Opus 5.5（精益形式化）·重要性 8/100。 Dow 和 Tkachuk 提出问题（问题 4.8）：假设对于每个可数 A \子集 C_p(X)，A 的闭包是伪完全的。吉洪诺夫空间 X 一定是 P 空间吗？这里 C_p(X) 是 X 上连续实值函数的空间，具有逐点收敛的拓扑，伪完备性是 Oxtoby 意义上的（一系列 pi 基，每个闭包嵌套选择都沿着该序列具有非空交集），并且 P 空间是其中每个 G_\delta 集都是开集的空间。

items.excerpt: Proved · Spectral geometry · with ChatGPT; Aristotle; Codex · significance 42/100. Does the Neumann Pólya conjecture hold for every bounded, connected planar Lipschitz domain \Omega\subset\mathbb R^2? More precisely, is it true that |\Omega|\mu_j(\Omega)\le 4\pi j \qquad(j\ge1), where 0=\mu_0(\Omega)<\mu_1(\Omega)\le\mu_2(\Omega)\le\cdots are the Neumann eigenvalues of \Omega, counted with multiplicity?

items.title: Wall's D(2) problem
items.excerpt: Disproved · Algebraic topology; homotopy types of 2-complexes · with Unreleased internal OpenAI model · significance 46/100. A finite connected CW complex X with fundamental group G satisfies the D(2) condition if H_i(\widetilde X;\mathbb Z)=0 for i>2 and H^3(X;M)=0 for every finitely generated \mathbb ZG-module M. Wall showed such X has a finite three-dimensional model and asked whether the three-cells can be removed. Stably the answer is yes (Cohen), and it is yes for many finite groups (Johnson, Hambleton, Hofmann-Nicholson); candidate counterexamples (Cohen-Dyer, Bridson-Tweedale) stayed unresolved or conditional

items.title: Gromov's integral scalar-curvature bound for simplicial volume
items.excerpt: Proved · Scalar curvature; simplicial volume and bounded cohomology · with Unreleased internal OpenAI model · significance 38/100. items.excerpt: Disproved · Operator algebras; near inclusions, perturbation theory · with Unreleased internal OpenAI model · significance 20/100. items.excerpt: Proved · Combinatorics on words; repetition-free morphisms · with OpenAI Codex · significance 6/100. Shallit, Shur and Zorcic ask for the phase transitions in admissible lengths of uniform binary morphisms preserving repetition avoidance.
